title: Ace High
synopsis: Fundamentally, Eli Wallach replays the same character he popularized in Sergio Leone's The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly, with a different name: Cacopulos from Greece. When a banker buys his freedom from jail to track down con-men Cat Stevens (Terence Hill) and Hutch (Bud Spencer), Cacopulos kills the banker and steals their loot instead. After losing the cash in a crooked casino run by Drake (Kevin McCarthy), the three form an uneasy alliance with a former-slave acrobat (Brock Peters) to pull off a revenge heist.

title: Adios Cjamango
alt_titles: Twenty Thousand Dollars for Every Corpse
synopsis: An obscure, loosely related sequel to Edward Muller's 1967 film Cjamango, this time starring Mike Rivers in the title role. Cjamango is a bounty hunter who decides to assist a young widow in her bitter range war against an evil land baron. The tyrannical villain is secretly assembling an underground army of outlaws and banditos to seize the territory.

title: Adios Gringo
synopsis: Brent Landers (Giuliano Gemma) is framed for cattle rustling and murder, forcing him to go on the run to hunt down the true swindler. Along the trail, he rescues Lucy (Evelyn Stewart), a traumatized woman attacked by three outlaws, including the son of a powerful local cattle baron. Gemma must fight off both corrupt lawmen and hired killers to clear his name. The film was a runaway smash hit in Italy, ranking as the fourth highest-grossing film of 1965.

title: Adios Hombre
synopsis: Master villain Eduardo Fajardo stars as the psychotic head of an outlaw gang that takes over a sleepy border-town saloon as a fortified hideout while waiting for a massive gold shipment. The gang terrorizes and slaughters the terrified townspeople. An escaped convict seeking redemption, Will Flarity (Craig Hill), decides to take a stand and wipes out the gang one by one.

title: Adios, Sabata
alt_titles: Indio Black, Sai Che Ti Dico...
synopsis: Originally written as Indio Black, this film was retitled during dubbing to capitalize on the massive success of Sabata. Dressed in all-black and sporting fringe bell-bottoms, Yul Brynner plays the stoic gunfighter leading an expedition to steal a fortune in gold from a sadistic Austrian commandant stationed in Mexico. Pop star Dean Reed co-stars as his flamboyant ball-tossing sidekick Ballantine.

title: Alive or Preferably Dead
synopsis: A breezy, lighthearted Western comedy starring Giuliano Gemma alongside real-life boxing champion Nino Benvenuti as two estranged brothers. City-slicker Monty and rustic bumpkin Ted are forced to live together peacefully for six straight months in order to inherit their late uncle's fortune. Chaos ensues when both fall hopelessly in love with the same feisty frontier girl (Sydne Rome).

title: All Out
synopsis: A rough-and-tumble caper Western directed by Italian cult horror icon Umberto Lenzi. John Ireland stars as a seasoned bounty hunter teaming up with a misunderstood outlaw (Mark Damon) to locate an elusive stash of stolen gold ingots. The duo must navigate a treacherous landscape populated by oddball killers like 'The Owl' and 'Copper Face', where double-crosses are an everyday currency.

title: Among Vultures
synopsis: Part of the classic German Karl May film series, featuring Stewart Granger as legendary frontier scout Old Surehand alongside Pierre Brice as Apache chief Winnetou. When a gang of ruthless outlaws disguised as Native Americans slaughters settlers and kidnaps a young woman (Elke Sommer), the heroic blood brothers track down the true culprits across the Rockies. Notably features an early genre appearance by Terence Hill.

title: And God Said to Cain
synopsis: A gothic, horror-infused revenge Western starring Klaus Kinski in a commanding lead role as Gary Hamilton. Framed for a robbery and sent to hard labor in a military prison for a decade, Hamilton is pardoned and returns on the night of a raging tornado to systematically eliminate the corrupt land baron who ruined his life. The dark, brooding atmosphere turns the standard revenge motif into an eerie ghost story.

title: And the Crows Will Dig Your Grave
alt_titles: I Corvi Ti Scaveranno la Fossa
synopsis: Wells Fargo hires cold-eyed bounty hunter Jess Sullivan (Craig Hill) to wipe out a ferocious gang of train robbers terrorizing their payroll lines. Sullivan springs a former gang member from a territorial prison to act as his tracker, initiating a violent, tense cat-and-mouse game across desolate Mexican landscapes. The film features classic genre heavies Fernando Sancho and snowy-haired Frank Braña.

title: And They Smelled the Strange, Exciting, Dangerous Scent of Dollars
alt_titles: Sentivano... Uno Strano Eccitante Pericoloso Puzzo di Dollari
synopsis: Boasting one of the most surreal and elaborate titles in Eurowestern history, this offbeat film follows charming outlaw Bronco Kid (Robert Malcolm) as he joins forces with eccentric bounty hunter Charity Jenkins. Together, they attempt to intercept and hijack a million-dollar payroll shipment orchestrated by a corrupt frontier financier. Features a brief appearance by fan-favorite genre queen Rosalba Neri.

title: Animal Called Man
synopsis: A tongue-in-cheek comedy clearly riding the coattails of the smash-hit Trinity films. Charming rogue Bill Masson (Vassili Karis) wins a local sharpshooting derby, earning five hundred dollars and a night with the saloon songstress (Lillian Bray), only to discover she is actually an undercover physician from Paris. When the disgruntled local boss attempts to assassinate him, full-scale comic warfare breaks out.

title: Another Man, Another Woman
alt_titles: Un Autre Homme, une Autre Chance
synopsis: Acclaimed French director Claude Lelouch crafts an arthouse Western romance starring James Caan as a widowed frontier veterinarian and Geneviève Bujold as an immigrant French widow trying to run a photography studio in New Mexico. Rather than focusing purely on gunfights, the film emphasizes breathtaking visual panoramas, delicate emotional storytelling, and the sheer harshness of frontier survival.

title: Anything for a Friend
alt_titles: Amico Mio, Frega Tu... Che Frego Io!
synopsis: A wonderfully outrageous slapstick effort from cult hack director Demofilo Fidani. Two small-time hustlers discover a rich gold seam in Dead Man's Gulch outside Denver, only to run afoul of the self-appointed town mayor and crooked saloon owner (Gordon Mitchell). Packed with Fidani's signature oddball humor, sight gags, and eccentric frontier characters.

title: Apache Woman
synopsis: A gritty, late-cycle Eurowestern mixing severe exploitation violence with 1970s softcore sensuality. A naive cavalry soldier named Tommy rescues a young Apache woman from an abusive gun-trafficker named Honest Jeremy. As the couple attempts to live in peace, the vindictive trader and his sadistic partners relentlessly stalk them through the wilderness, culminating in a brutal, uncompromising climax.

title: Apache's Last Battle
synopsis: Filmed in 70mm Superpanorama across the majestic Yugoslavian mountain ranges, this lavish European production stars Lex Barker as Old Shatterhand and Pierre Brice as Winnetou. The blood brothers strive to broker peace on the frontier while a renegade, glory-seeking cavalry officer (Guy Madison) schemes to trigger a total Indian war to seize sacred tribal lands.

title: Apocalypse Joe
synopsis: Anthony Steffen stars as Joe Clifford, a wandering, Shakespeare-quoting actor who is secretly one of the deadliest vigilantes in the territory. Upon arriving in the town of Landberry to claim a gold mine left to him by his late uncle, he discovers that a corrupt syndicate led by town boss Berg (Eduardo Fajardo) has seized the operation and terrorized the citizens. Joe straps on his guns to reclaim his inheritance.

title: Arizona
alt_titles: If You Gotta Shoot Someone... Bang! Bang!
synopsis: A dark and stylish revenge Western directed by Italian thriller maestro Sergio Martino. Retired bounty hunter Arizona Colt is framed for horse thievery by his old nemesis Keene (Aldo Sambrell). After faking his execution to live quietly, Keene raids his ranch, murdering Arizona's companions. Enraged, Arizona sets out on a merciless hunt, wiping out the entire outlaw outfit.

title: Arizona Colt
synopsis: Giuliano Gemma portrays legendary drifter Arizona Colt, who is forcibly freed from prison by Mexican bandit Gordon Watch (Fernando Sancho) to recruit him into his gang. Refusing to become an outlaw, Colt travels to Blackstone City to protect the settlement from the gang's impending raid. Filled with high-flying stunts, quick-draw action, and memorable performances by Sancho and Rosalba Neri.

title: Arizona Kid
synopsis: A singular historical oddity as the only Italian-Filipino co-produced Western ever made. Philippine comedy icon Chaquito stars as a bumbling wanderer who is mistaken for a mythical gunfighter named the Arizona Kid and hired to defend the village of Sierra Vista from a brutal gang led by Gordon Mitchell. 1950s Hollywood bombshell Mamie Van Doren co-stars.

title: Armed and Dangerous: Time and Heroes of Bret Harte
synopsis: An ambitious Soviet-produced Western based loosely on the classic frontier tales of American writer Bret Harte. The narrative follows a gold prospector, a spirited dancehall singer, and the fictionalized author himself as they join forces to protect struggling homesteaders from a tyrannical oil tycoon seeking to monopolize the valley's mineral rights.

title: Awkward Hands
synopsis: Peter Lee Lawrence plays Kitt, a peace-loving ranch hand beaten and left to die in the arid plains for daring to love the daughter of a wealthy cattle baron. Nursed back to health and schooled in the fatal art of gunfighting by a mysterious Chinese mentor, Kitt transforms into an ice-cold avenger, culminating in a savage confrontation with a lethal whip-wielding bounty hunter.

title: Man Called Noon
synopsis: Based on a Louis L'Amour novel. Richard Crenna stars as Noon, an amnesiac gunslinger recovering from a gunshot wound to the head. Aided by an outlaw companion (Stephen Boyd) and a fiery senorita (Rosanna Schiaffino), Noon pieces together his forgotten past and tracks down the murderous gang responsible for the deaths of his wife and child.

title: Man Called Sledge
synopsis: James Garner delivers a gritty, atypical performance as Luther Sledge, an outlaw who infiltrates an impenetrable territorial prison to steal a $300,000 gold cache. After the daring robbery succeeds, mutual greed and paranoia cause the gang members to violently turn against each other until almost none survive.

title: Man from Canyon City
alt_titles: L'Uomo Che Viene da Canyon City
synopsis: A direct sequel to Five Thousand Dollars on One Ace. Gambler Jeff Clayton (Robert Woods) and colorful Mexican bandido Carrancio (Fernando Sancho) escape together from a prison chain gang. The two form an unlikely criminal alliance, getting involved in a town feud that showcases Sancho's charismatic persona.

title: Man from Oklahoma
director: Jaime J. Balcazar / Roberto Montero (as Robert M. White)
synopsis: The newly appointed sheriff of Wagon Wheel (Rick Horn) is determined to dismantle a marauding gang of outlaws. Convinced that an influential local land baron is secretly financing the raids to force settlers off their claims, the sheriff engages in a protracted cat-and-mouse game to prove the tycoon's guilt.

title: Man of the Cursed Valley
synopsis: A frontier drama following a white woman (Iran Eory) who marries a Native American warrior and is disowned by her family. When she is captured by a hostile rival tribe, a roaming gunslinger (Ty Hardin) steps in to secure her rescue and mediate a reconciliation with her stubborn rancher father.

title: Man of the East
alt_titles: E Poi lo Chiamarono il Magnifico
synopsis: Directed by Trinity creator Enzo Barboni, this comedy stars Terence Hill as Sir Thomas More, an aristocratic English dandy sent west to become a 'real man.' Guided by three aging outlaw friends of his late father, the cultured newcomer bewilders local frontier bullies by overcoming gunfights and brawls with refined British etiquette.

title: Man Who Cried for Revenge
synopsis: Anthony Steffen plays Drake, a brooding, vengeful gunman returning to his hometown to execute the three men who raped and murdered his wife. Finding the killers entrenched in positions of wealth and power under the protection of a regional boss, Drake methodically eliminates them one by one.

title: Man Who Killed Billy the Kid
alt_titles: I'll Kill Him and Return Alone
Hombre Que Mató Billy el Niño
synopsis: A Spanish-Italian revisionist take on the Lincoln County War. Peter Lee Lawrence portrays Billy the Kid as a misunderstood youth forced into violence by circumstances and local corruption. Fausto Tozzi co-stars as Sheriff Pat Garrett, who is torn between his personal affection for Billy and his sworn duty to uphold the law.

title: Man with the Golden Pistol
synopsis: Finding the corpse of a notorious gunman, an outlaw on the run (Carl Möhner) assumes the dead man's identity and is hired as town sheriff by a regional marshal. Hoping to leave his criminal past behind, the new lawman successfully defends the community from a Mexican gang led by Fernando Sancho.

title: Manhunt
synopsis: A modern-day neo-western produced in Italy. John Ethan Wayne (son of John Wayne) plays an innocent stranger who stops to water his horses on land owned by a corrupt rancher (Ernest Borgnine). After being framed by a crooked sheriff (Bo Svenson) and brutalized by a sadistic prison warden (Henry Silva), he escapes to wage a personal war of retribution.

title: Massacre at Fort Grant
synopsis: When their stagecoach is attacked by warring Apaches, newlyweds take refuge inside Fort Grant alongside other desperate survivors. Paranoia breaks out inside the besieged garrison when the officer in charge is falsely accused of being a traitor working with the hostiles.

title: Massacre at Fort Holman
alt_titles: Reason to Live, a Reason to Die
Una Ragione per Vivere... una Ragione per Morire
synopsis: A Civil War adventure heavily influenced by The Dirty Dozen. Disgraced Union Colonel Pembroke (James Coburn) recruits seven condemned military prisoners, including a brawling looter (Bud Spencer), to mount a near-suicidal raid to recapture a strategic fort held by a fanatical Confederate major (Telly Savalas).

title: Massacre at Grand Canyon
director: Albert Band / Sergio Corbucci (as Stanley Corbett)
synopsis: An important historical curiosity codirected by Sergio Corbucci and Albert Band a year before Fistful of Dollars. James Mitchum (son of Robert Mitchum) stars as a young man seeking vengeance for his father's murder, finding himself caught in a violent range war over ownership of lush pastureland.

title: Massacre at Marble City
synopsis: Based on a classic novel by Friedrich Gerstäcker, this German-Italian co-production depicts the lawless chaos that engulfs Marble City following a major gold strike. A courageous rancher (Brad Harris) and a native chief team up to restore order when greedy claim-jumpers disguise themselves as Indians to massacre settlers.

title: Massacre Time
synopsis: Lucio Fulci's first Eurowestern is a masterpiece of dynamic violence. Gold prospector Tom (Franco Nero) returns to his home valley after receiving an urgent summons, only to find his family estate taken over by a sadistic tyrant named Jason (Nino Castelnuovo). Allied with his alcoholic half-brother (George Hilton), Tom wages an explosive, bullet-riddled assault on the hacienda.

title: Matalo!
synopsis: An avant-garde, psychedelic western renowned for its minimal dialogue, distorted angles, and heavy fuzz-guitar soundtrack. A gang of ruthless outlaws takes refuge in a dusty ghost town where an enigmatic wanderer named Ray (Lou Castel), who uses Australian boomerangs alongside six-shooters, eliminates the invaders.

title: May God Forgive You... But I Won't
alt_titles: Chiedi Perdono a Dio... Non a Me
synopsis: A grim, uncompromising revenge drama starring George Ardisson as Cjamango. Returning home to find his father, brother, and sister ruthlessly murdered by an outlaw syndicate during a land dispute, Cjamango embarks on a merciless, blood-drenched campaign across the territory until every killer is dead.

title: Mercenary
synopsis: A classic revolutionary adventure from Sergio Corbucci. Franco Nero plays Sergei Kowalski, a polished European mercenary hired by a charismatic peasant insurgent named Paco (Tony Musante) to lead a rebellion against the corrupt Mexican regime, all while pursued by a curly-haired, sadistic bounty hunter named Ricciolo (Jack Palance).

title: Minnesota Clay
synopsis: Sergio Corbucci's first solo western. Cameron Mitchell stars as Minnesota Clay, an aging gunfighter serving a prison sentence on false charges. Escaping custody, he returns to his hometown to prove his innocence and protect his estranged daughter, battling through shootouts while gradually losing his eyesight.

title: Minute to Pray, a Second to Die
alt_titles: Minuto per Pregare, un Istante per Morire
synopsis: Alex Cord plays Clay McCord, a notorious outlaw afflicted with severe paralytic seizures. Seeking an amnesty offered by the territorial governor (Robert Ryan) so he can retire in peace, McCord finds his path blocked by a vindictive sheriff (Arthur Kennedy) obsessed with gunning him down.

title: Miss Dynamite
alt_titles: Tutti Fratelli nel West... per Parte di Padre
synopsis: A lively, comedic frontier caper where Antonio Sabàto and an eccentric group of wandering rogues get caught up in a chaotic scramble to locate a hidden cache of gold coins, constantly staying one step ahead of rival outlaws and an overbearing Mexican bandit chief (Fernando Sancho).

title: The Moment to Kill
synopsis: Two rival bounty hunters, Lord and Bull (George Hilton and Walter Barnes), arrive in a frontier town searching for half a million dollars in hidden Confederate gold. The key to the treasure rests with a paralyzed young woman, drawing the pair into a violent confrontation with a ruthless town boss (Horst Frank).

title: Montana Trap
synopsis: A rare German-produced comedy-western starring Hardy Krüger as Potato Fritz, an eccentric settler determined to cultivate potatoes on the frontier. Taking shelter inside Fort Benton with his companion (Stephen Boyd) during an Indian raid, he butts heads with a rigid Prussian officer (Anton Diffring).

title: More Dollars for the MacGregors
alt_titles: Few More Dollars for the MacGregors
synopsis: When an outlaw gang slaughters a bounty hunter's girlfriend, the tracker allies with an enigmatic blond stranger named Blondie (Peter Lee Lawrence) to eliminate the killers. After the climactic gun battle, Blondie reveals that the murdered woman was his sister, leading to a personal confrontation over negligence.

title: Murieta
synopsis: Jeffrey Hunter stars as the legendary historical figure Joaquin Murieta, a peaceful Mexican immigrant arriving in California during the 1849 Gold Rush. When his wife is assaulted and murdered by racist miners, Murieta loses his mind to rage, launching a wave of guerrilla raids across the mining camps.

title: Mutiny at Fort Sharp
synopsis: During the American Civil War, a detachment of French soldiers accidentally enters Confederate territory in Texas and is integrated into Fort Sharp. The soldiers gradually realize that the paranoid fortress commander, Colonel Lennox (Broderick Crawford), is hallucinating an impending native siege.

title: My Colt, Not Yours
alt_titles: La Mia Colt Ti Cerca... Quattro Ceri Ti Attendono
synopsis: Robert Woods delivers a frenetic, eccentric performance as Sheriff Garingo, a borderline-deranged lawman who takes on a corrupt saloon proprietor and town boss (Cris Huerta) running a frontier municipality with syndicate-like extortion tactics.

title: My Horse, My Gun, Your Widow
alt_titles: Domani, Passo a Salutare la Tua Vedova... Parola di Epidemia
synopsis: Craig Hill plays Dr. Janos Saxon, who robs a frontier security bank alongside partners only to be betrayed and stripped of the cash by a greedy bandit chief (Cris Huerta). Accompanied by a female companion, Saxon spends the remainder of the narrative pulling off elaborate ruses to reclaim the stolen funds.

title: My Name Is Nobody
synopsis: A brilliant, elegiac masterpiece produced and conceived by Sergio Leone. Terence Hill plays Nobody, an agile, easygoing drifter who hero-worships aging legendary gunfighter Jack Beauregard (Henry Fonda). Hoping to give his idol a magnificent, historic sendoff into retirement, Nobody tricks Beauregard into single-handedly facing the 150-strong Wild Bunch.

title: My Name Is Pecos
synopsis: Robert Woods stars as Pecos Martinez, a Mexican gunfighter who rides into a dusty settlement to settle an old score with Joe Kline (Peter Carsten), the ruthless syndicate boss who murdered his family years earlier. A grim, atmospheric revenge western featuring an uncredited appearance by George Eastman.

title: Navajo Joe
synopsis: Burt Reynolds stars as Navajo Joe, the sole survivor of a massacre of his tribe by a gang of scalp-hunting bandits led by Marvin Duncan (Aldo Sambrell). Joe tracks the gang to the town of Esperanza, offering to exterminate the outlaws for a bounty of one dollar per head. Features an iconic, operatic vocal score by Ennio Morricone.

title: Ned Kelly
synopsis: Rock icon Mick Jagger takes on the role of Australia's most famous bushranger, Ned Kelly, charting his transformation from an impoverished horse thief into a heavily armored folk hero waging an armed rebellion against colonial police oppression across Victoria.

title: Nephews of Zorro
synopsis: Italian comedy team Franco and Ciccio travel to Gold Rush-era California and falsely boast of being the legendary masked vigilante Zorro to impress local women. The ruse backfires when the tyrannical garrison commander sentences them to hang, requiring the genuine Zorro (Dean Reed) to ride to their rescue.

title: Night of the Serpent
synopsis: An intense, claustrophobic drama directed by Giulio Petroni. A vicious bandit known as The Serpent (Luigi Pistilli) and his gang become trapped inside a frontier saloon following an attempted bank robbery, holding the patrons hostage while a lone gunfighter (Luke Askew) waits for the right moment to strike.

title: No Graves on Boot Hill
synopsis: A Dirty Dozen-inspired western where a frontier priest (Peter White) recruits three convicted criminals—a womanizer (Craig Hill), a petty thief, and a mercenary—to help him clear an innocent boy sentenced to the gallows by uncovering the true murderer.

title: No Room to Die
synopsis: Anthony Steffen plays the stoic bounty hunter Brandon (Django in international prints) who forms an uneasy partnership with a Bible-quoting preacher (William Berger) to dismantle an illegal human-trafficking ring smuggling Mexican laborers into slave labor on local ranches.

title: None of the Three Were Called Trinity
alt_titles: Ninguno de los Tres se Llamaba Trinidad
synopsis: A satirical comedy poking fun at the endless Trinity imitators. A young traveler named Jim (Danny Martin) is mistakenly arrested as a bank robber and must convince a dimwitted sheriff (Cris Huerta) of his innocence so he can pursue his dishonest cousins who stole his inheritance.

title: Nude Django
alt_titles: Django Nudo und die lusternen Mädchen von Porno Hill
synopsis: An obscure German-produced softcore sex-western curiosity. Peter Graf plays an eccentric wanderer calling himself Django who lures a frontier dance-hall entertainer to his isolated cabin with promises of sharing a rich gold mine claim.

title: On the Third Day Arrived the Crow
synopsis: A family of frontier troubleshooters—Sally and her brothers Link and Tornado—investigate the mysterious disappearance of a gold shipment from a local mining company. They discover the robbery was staged by the mine owner himself, who hires a lethal assassin known as The Crow (William Berger) to silence them. When Tornado is slain, Link mounts a retaliatory strike, leading to an unexpected showdown with The Crow's vengeful brother.

title: Once Upon a Time in the West
alt_titles: Play Me the Song of Death
synopsis: Sergio Leone's operatic masterpiece chronicling the inevitable decline of the Old West with the advance of the transcontinental railroad. A mysterious, harmonica-playing avenger (Charles Bronson) and a charismatic outlaw named Cheyenne (Jason Robards) protect a resilient widow (Claudia Cardinale) whose family was slaughtered by Frank (Henry Fonda in a chilling against-type villainous turn), a cold-blooded assassin executing land grabs for a crippled railroad tycoon.

title: Once Upon a Time in the Wild, Wild West
alt_titles: C'era una Volta questo Pazzo Pazzo West
synopsis: A slapstick farce following two squabbling brothers who leave their impoverished farm to seek their fortunes in Carson City with their cousin Bill (Gordon Mitchell). Upon arrival, they discover the settlement embroiled in a violent feud between Bill and a local bully named Blackie, with the brothers stumbling through juvenile brawls and frontier scrapes.

title: One After Another
synopsis: When a frontier bank is plundered and its employees massacred, an unassuming stranger named Sam (Richard Harrison) arrives in town to avenge his murdered companion. Tricked by the crooked bank president into targeting a notorious Mexican bandit leader (José Bodalo), Sam eventually uncovers the deception and teams up with the outlaw to bring down the true conspirators.

title: One Against One... No Mercy
synopsis: Peter Lee Lawrence plays Chico, a quick-draw marksman betrayed by his conniving partner Grayson (William Bogart) during a high-stakes scheme. When Grayson attempts to frame a regional town boss by extorting a confession under duress, Chico unravels the layers of treachery and tracks down his former associate for an icy final duel.

title: One Damned Day at Dawn... Django Meets Sartana
alt_titles: Quel Maledetto Giorno d'Inverno Django e Sartana... all'Ultimo Sangue
synopsis: In the lawless outpost of Black City, a tyrannical town boss and his Mexican bandit allies operate a lucrative gun-running syndicate. Newly appointed sheriff Jack Ronson (Fabio Testi) arrives to establish order and finds an unexpected ally in a mysterious, watching bounty hunter named Django (Hunt Powers), culminating in an early morning street showdown.

title: One Hundred Thousand Dollars for Ringo
synopsis: A Texas Ranger named Ringo (Richard Harrison) arrives incognito in a turbulent border settlement divided by two warring factions fighting over buried Confederate treasure. Maintaining order through precision shooting, Ringo plays both sides against each other to break the syndicate's stranglehold on the community.

title: Outlaw of Red River
synopsis: A former frontier lawman (George Montgomery) falsely accused of murder flees across the border into Mexico, becoming the chief lieutenant for a powerful regional general. Complications quickly escalate as he navigates the general's manipulative lover, an ambitious rival, and raiding bandits seeking to destabilize the territory.

title: Paid in Blood
synopsis: Bounty hunter Tom Carter (Jeff Cameron) rides into Rio Canyon seeking retribution for the robbery and murder of his brother. Suspecting a saloon entertainer, he soon realizes she is innocent and joins forces with her to expose a ruthless gang of cattle thieves and land swindlers commanded by a vicious town boss (Donald O'Brien).

title: Pancho Villa
synopsis: Telly Savalas stars as the larger-than-life Mexican revolutionary general Pancho Villa. After being betrayed in a fraudulent weapons transaction with American arms suppliers, Villa rallies his insurgent army, crosses the border, and launches a daring assault on a U.S. military outpost, culminating in a spectacular collision between two locomotives.

title: Paths of War
synopsis: A broad Civil War slapstick parody loosely spoofing The Red Badge of Courage. Lowbrow comedians Franco and Ciccio play two hopelessly cowardly Confederate army cooks who become separated from their unit and bumble their way through enemy lines, hostile outlaws, and native war parties.

title: Patience Has a Limit, We Don't
alt_titles: La Pazienza Ha un Limite... Noi No
synopsis: Cult horror filmmaker Armando De Ossorio directs this frontier comedy about a veteran cavalry lieutenant who has been denied promotion for twenty years due to a missing $20,000 gold payroll. The plot descends into farce when the original bandit's two illiterate sons locate the treasure map and wander aimlessly across the frontier.

title: Payment in Blood
director: Enzo G. Castellari (as E. G. Rowland)
synopsis: A rogue Confederate colonel (Guy Madison) refuses to surrender after the Civil War, leading a ruthless gang of marauders pillaging the countryside while searching for a hidden Confederate treasury. An undercover government operative (Edd Byrnes) infiltrates the outfit to locate the treasure and neutralize the renegades.

title: Pecos Cleans Up
alt_titles: Pecos È Qui: Prega e Muori
synopsis: A lighter, adventure-oriented sequel to My Name Is Pecos. Robert Woods returns as Pecos, who embarks on a treasure-hunting expedition into the Mexican wilderness to locate lost Aztec ruins and hidden gold, contending with rival mercenaries, booby-trapped temples, and opportunistic local bandits.

title: Piluk, the Timid One
alt_titles: Giurò... E li Uccise ad Uno ad Uno
synopsis: A unique revenge western featuring an elderly protagonist. When his only son, the respected sheriff of Boise, is murdered by the ruthless Mason gang, an unassuming old frontiersman named Piluk (Edmund Purdom) discards his peaceful ways and sets out on a methodical, calculated mission of vengeance.

title: Pirates of the Mississippi
synopsis: An early German-Italian-French co-production revolving around a gang of river pirates who hijack a mail boat carrying a Cherokee land grant and take over a frontier trading town. Pioneers and local native tribes set aside their mutual distrust to join forces under an American frontiersman (Brad Harris) to liberate the river valley.

title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
synopsis: Wrongfully convicted and imprisoned for a crime he didn't commit, a young gunfighter known as The Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence) is released and attempts to track down the true culprit. His quest takes a bizarre and violent turn when a gang of axe-wielding asylum escapees led by Eduardo Fajardo takes a nearby town hostage.

title: Pistol for Ringo
synopsis: A genre-defining hit from Duccio Tessari. Following a violent bank raid, wounded Mexican bandit Sancho (Fernando Sancho) and his gang seize a wealthy hacienda, taking hostages. The local authorities enlist imprisoned gunslinger Ringo (Giuliano Gemma), an agile angel-faced marksman with a love for milk and money, to infiltrate the stronghold and orchestrate a rescue.

title: Pistol Packin' Preacher
synopsis: A con-artist family traveling west stages an elaborate 'faith healing' miracle with an undercover Confederate deserter named Slim (Mark Damon). When the grateful town boss appoints the patriarch as the town's official minister, Slim orchestrates a series of fraudulent miracles and a staged resurrection to swindle the syndicate's wealth.

title: Place Called Glory
synopsis: Pairing German cinema legends Lex Barker and Pierre Brice in an American-style western, the story follows a veteran bounty hunter and a dapper New Orleans gunslinger who meet on the plains and form a close friendship. Arriving in Glory City, their bond is tested when competing loyalties and a love triangle force them toward a high-noon showdown.

title: Poker with Pistols
synopsis: A bankrupt gambler named Lucas (George Eastman) incurs a massive debt during a poker game with seasoned player Ponson (George Hilton). In exchange for forgiving the loss, Ponson recruits Lucas to spy on a wealthy regional rancher suspected of running a large-scale counterfeit currency operation.

title: Porno-Erotic Western
synopsis: An exploitative hybrid production created by an Italian film distributor that took Mel Welles' 1970 western Requiem for a Bounty Hunter, excised portions of the original narrative, and inserted hardcore erotic footage to market the hybrid feature to adult theater circuits under a pseudonym.

title: Prairie in the City
synopsis: An experimental, avant-garde German drama blending contemporary urban politics with frontier tropes. Two modern businessmen discover they are carrying on an affair with the same woman; deciding to resolve their romantic conflict in western fashion, they don full cowboy regalia and stalk each other with six-guns through city rush-hour traffic.

title: Prey of Vultures
synopsis: Peter Lee Lawrence plays Kit, a peaceful magazine illustrator with hidden, lethal marksman skills. After witnessing his father's murder during a stagecoach robbery, Kit relocates to a quiet mountain settlement, falling for the sheriff's daughter before discovering the lawman is secretly the mastermind behind the gang.

title: Price of Death
synopsis: When local troublemaker Chester Conway (Klaus Kinski) is convicted of murder and sentenced to hang on circumstantial evidence, his attorney recruits retired bounty hunter Silver (Gianni Garko) to investigate. Silver exposes the true conspiracy, only to face Conway in a final duel after discovering he committed a separate unsolved killing.

title: Price of Power
synopsis: A political thriller allegorizing the JFK assassination within a 19th-century western framework. President Garfield (Van Johnson) is assassinated while visiting Dallas, and corrupt local officials frame an innocent black man for the crime. A lone frontiersman (Giuliano Gemma) uncovers the conspiracy orchestrated by wealthy former Confederate bankers.

title: Pyramid of the Sun God
synopsis: The concluding chapter of Robert Siodmak's two-part epic based on Karl May's Aztec adventure tales. Dr. Karl Sternau (Lex Barker) and his loyal allies navigate Mexican revolutionary conflicts, hostile native tribes, and scheming French mercenaries to protect a sacred, ancient Aztec treasure cache.

title: Quinta: Fighting Proud
synopsis: A rare and obscure Eurowestern directed by Leon Klimovsky that saw limited theatrical release during the late-60s genre glut. The narrative centers on a rugged frontiersman who relies on cunning and marksmanship to survive in a violent border territory dominated by opportunistic outlaws.

title: Quintana: Dead or Alive
synopsis: George Stevenson stars as Quintana, a masked, poncho-clad people's hero fighting for peasant rights in colonial Mexico. When his peaceful companion is framed for murder by a tyrannical provincial governor pursuing the man's beautiful fiancée (Femi Benussi), Quintana mounts a daring rescue mission.

title: Raise Your Hands, Dead Man... You're Under Arrest
alt_titles: Su le Mani, Cadavere! Sei agli Arresti
synopsis: A Texas Ranger known as Sando Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence) goes undercover as an eccentric traveling perfume salesman to investigate land-grabbing baron Mancino. Discovering the tycoon plans to evict local ranchers before the railroad arrives, Sando and an ally set a trap that culminates in a massive town gun battle.

title: Ramon the Mexican
synopsis: A grim, violent revenge western. Ruthless outlaw leader Ramon (Jean Louis) raids the Baxter ranch, killing the owner and abducting his sister. When the woman's fiancé (Robert Hundar) is severely wounded trying to stop them, he recovers and infiltrates the bandit stronghold disguised as a priest during an open-air wedding ceremony to execute his revenge.

title: Rampage at Apache Wells
synopsis: Part of the popular German Karl May franchise. Frontier scout Old Surehand (Stewart Granger) and Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice) intervene when unscrupulous white speculators attempt to trick local tribes into an all-out war in order to seize valuable petroleum-rich lands.

title: Rattler Kid
synopsis: Falsely accused of robbery and murder during a court-martial, Lieutenant Tony Garnett (Richard Wyler) escapes custody and tracks down the real culprits. Adopting the outlaw persona of 'The Rattler Kid,' he eventually joins forces with a determined sheriff (Brad Harris) to defend a frontier town during a bank raid.

title: Reach You Bastard!
alt_titles: Down with Your Hands... You Scum!
synopsis: A notorious clip-show feature directed by Demofilo Fidani. In a border saloon, Wild Bill Hickok (Dean Stratford) meets legendary bounty killer Django (Hunt Powers), who recounts his most violent exploits, prompting a series of flashbacks repurposed from earlier Fidani westerns.

title: Rebels of Arizona
synopsis: A traditional Spanish-filmed frontier drama following a hardy community of Arizona pioneers. The settlers spend the narrative defending their isolated ranches and homesteads from repeated, coordinated raids launched by Mexican bandidos and hostile native tribes.

title: Red Blood, Yellow Gold
synopsis: Three loyal rogue comrades—an ex-priest explosives expert, a sharp-shooting bank robber, and a Mexican horse thief—are dispatched into the desert to recover a stolen Confederate gold payroll and a rapid-fire machine gun hijacked by an unscrupulous mercenary officer (Gerard Herter).

title: Red Coat
synopsis: Inspired by Jack London's adventure stories and the success of Call of the Wild. Fabio Testi plays a courageous Canadian Mountie who, accompanied by his faithful dog, rescues an orphaned youth in the wilderness and protects him from harsh weather, predatory wolves, and a band of murderous renegades.

title: Red Hot Zorro
synopsis: A lighthearted French-Belgian adult western comedy. Jean-Michel Dhermay portrays an amorous incarnation of Zorro who uses his swordsmanship, charm, and athletic wit to outmaneuver an authoritarian California governor while engaging in comedic romantic exploits with local women.

title: Red Sun
synopsis: A landmark East-meets-West international co-production. When a treacherous outlaw (Alain Delon) robs a train and steals a ceremonial gold katana intended for the American President, a betrayed gang member (Charles Bronson) and an honorable samurai warrior (Toshiro Mifune) form an unlikely alliance to track the bandit across the frontier.

title: Relentless Four
synopsis: TV's Batman, Adam West, stars as Marshall Garrett, an honest lawman who intervenes to stop a corrupt bounty hunter (Robert Hundar) from collecting an unlawful reward. Framed for murder in retaliation, Garrett must wage an all-out range war to clear his name and expose the true conspirators.

title: Requiem for a Bounty Hunter
synopsis: When an outlaw gang raids his farm and murders his family on orders from an extortionist town boss, homesteader Tom (Ray O'Connor) hires an enigmatic, flute-playing bounty hunter named Sabata to help him track down the perpetrators for a cold-blooded reckoning.

title: Return of Clint the Stranger
synopsis: George Martin directs and stars, reprising his role as gunslinger Clint Harrison. Clint attempts to settle down peacefully with his family, but finds his quiet life shattered when an aggressive gang of cattle-rustling mercenaries (featuring Klaus Kinski) terrorizes the valley, forcing him to draw his guns again.

title: Return of Halleluja
alt_titles: The West Is Very Close, Amigo
Il West Ti Fa Stretto, Amico... È Arrivato Alleluia
synopsis: A fast-paced comedy-heist sequel to Heads You Die... Tails I Kill You. George Hilton returns as the dapper rogue Hallelujah, partnering with an eccentric strongman and an agile female thief to locate and steal a valuable Aztec religious idol amidst an endless sequence of double-crosses.

title: Return of Ringo
synopsis: An acclaimed dramatic sequel to A Pistol for Ringo loosely adapting the Odyssey myth. Giuliano Gemma plays a traumatized Civil War soldier who returns home in disguise to find his community seized, his father slain, and his wife held captive by a vicious Mexican bandit family led by Fernando Sancho.

title: Return of Sabata
alt_titles: È Tornato Sabata, Hai Chiuso un'Altra Volta
synopsis: Lee Van Cleef reprises his iconic role as the gadget-wielding bounty hunter Sabata. Working as a traveling circus marksman, Sabata arrives in Hobsonville and uncovers an elaborate municipal tax swindle orchestrated by an Irish town boss who is laundering counterfeit currency through local businesses.

title: Return of Shanghai Joe
synopsis: A comedic sequel to Fighting Fists of Shanghai Joe. Wandering martial artist Shanghai Joe (Chen Lee) teams up with a traveling medicine-show quack to protect a frontier town from a corrupt, cigar-chomping town boss played with eccentric relish by Klaus Kinski.

title: Revenge for Revenge
synopsis: A bitter, cynical frontier drama. When an army major (John Ireland) discovers his unfaithful wife has given the location of his hidden gold cache to her outlaw lover, he kills her and embarks on a desert hunt to recover the treasure, resulting in a mutual shootout where neither man survives.

title: Reverend Colt
synopsis: A peaceful former gunfighter turned preacher (Guy Madison) arrives in Tucson to open a church, only to be falsely accused of an armed bank raid pulled by Mexican outlaws. An open-minded sheriff (Richard Harrison) grants him temporary release to track down the true gang and clear his name.

title: The Reward's Yours, the Man's Mine
alt_titles: La Taglia È Tua, l'Uomo l'Ammazzo Io
synopsis: Robert Woods plays a hardened bounty hunter hired to capture an elusive fugitive alive so the man can stand trial. When unexpected violence forces him to shoot the outlaw instead, the story culminates in a bitterly ironic climax regarding who collects the reward.

title: Rick and John, Conquerors of the West
alt_titles: Rick and John in the Conquest of the West
Ric e Gian alla Conquista del West
synopsis: A military comedy following two bumbling Union army conscripts who are entrusted with transporting a wagon equipped with solid gold wheels to pay for cavalry horses. Oblivious to the wheels' true value, the pair trade them away to local natives, triggering an absurd frontier pursuit.

title: Ride and Kill
director: José Luis Borau / Mario Caiano (as J. L. Boraw)
synopsis: A syndicate of corrupt town officials hires a lethal assassin (Robert Hundar) to murder the local marshal and replaces him with the town drunk, Brandy (Alex Nicol), expecting an easily manipulated puppet. Reformed by his new badge and the support of a barmaid, Brandy takes a courageous stand.

title: Ringo: Face of Revenge
synopsis: Two adventurers (Anthony Steffen and Frank Wolff) rescue a wounded Mexican outlaw and discover half of a secret treasure map tattooed onto his back. Partnering to find the other half tattooed onto a local sheriff, the gunslingers become embroiled in a violent quest for hidden frontier gold.

title: Ringo and Gringo Against All
synopsis: A Civil War farce starring Italian comedy team Lando Buzzanca and Raimondo Vianello as two dimwitted Confederate soldiers stationed at an isolated frontier outpost who remain completely unaware that the war ended eight years earlier, continuing their sabotage operations.

title: Ringo and His Golden Pistol
synopsis: Mark Damon stars as Johnny Oro (retitled Ringo in international markets), an extravagant bounty hunter who uses customized solid-gold pistols and dynamite. When he arrests an outlaw chieftain's brother, the bandit gang lays siege to the town of Coldstone, forcing Oro into an explosive defense.

title: Ringo, It's Massacre Time
synopsis: Bodybuilder Mickey Hargitay stars as a determined frontier marksman who arrives in a corrupt territory to track down an elusive bandit ring terrorizing isolated ranches and mining transports, taking justice into his own hands when local authorities prove helpless.

title: Ringo, the Lone Rider
synopsis: Citizens of Springfield hire a formidable wandering gunfighter named Ringo (Peter Martell) to protect their community from an oppressive gang of outlaws commanded by Bill Anderson (Piero Lulli). Ringo uses sniper tactics and quick-draw ambushes to eradicate the threat.

title: Ringo's Big Night
synopsis: Jack Balman (William Berger) is framed by a town mayor and his corrupt associates for a $200,000 stagecoach robbery. Escaping custody, Balman infiltrates the corrupt network and systematically exposes the civic leaders who engineered the crime.

title: Rita of the West
synopsis: A pop-musical western spoof starring Italian singing sensation Rita Pavone as a quick-drawing female champion of justice. When she falls for a deceptive outlaw named Black Star (Terence Hill) who intends to rob sacred native gold, she embarks on an absurd series of musical numbers and comedic duels.

title: Road to Fort Alamo
synopsis: Directed by Italian horror maestro Mario Bava. An outlaw named Arizona Bill (Ken Clark) leads a bank robbery disguised in Union uniforms, but redeems himself after being abandoned in the desert when he rescues a federal wagon train heading for Fort Alamo from hostile raiders.

title: Rojo
synopsis: A mysterious, black-clad gunman calling himself El Rojo (Richard Harrison) arrives in a mining town to methodically assassinate four prominent local leaders. In the final confrontation, Rojo reveals that the corrupt men murdered his entire family years ago to steal their lucrative gold claim.

title: Roy Colt and Winchester Jack
synopsis: Mario Bava directs an eccentric comedic western following two lifelong outlaw companions, Roy and Jack (Brett Halsey and Charles Southwood), whose partnership dissolves when Roy decides to become the sheriff of Carson City. The former friends must reunite to stop a deranged preacher searching for hidden gold.

title: Run Man, Run
synopsis: A direct sequel to The Big Gundown. Tomás Milian reprises his iconic role as the agile, knife-throwing Mexican peasant Cuchillo. Released from prison, Cuchillo must stay one step ahead of French mercenaries, federal agents, and American opportunists to locate a fortune in revolutionary gold.

title: Ruthless Colt of the Gringo
synopsis: Wrongfully imprisoned for the murder of a mine proprietor, innocent gunslinger Sol Lester (Jim Reed) is released and returns to Paso City seeking retribution. Allied with the murdered man's daughter, he takes on the ruthless town boss who framed him.

title: The Ruthless Four
synopsis: A tense, character-driven masterpiece of suspicion and greed. Aging prospector Sam Cooper (Van Heflin) discovers a massive gold deposit and recruits his estranged adopted son (George Hilton), an old associate (Gilbert Roland), and a sinister blond mercenary (Klaus Kinski) to transport the ore, with lethal paranoia destroying their alliance.

title: Sabata
alt_titles: Ehi, Amico... C'è Sabata, Hai Chiuso!
Hey, Friend, There Is Sabata... You've Closed
synopsis: The film that coined the iconic tag 'The man with gunsight eyes'. Lee Van Cleef stars as the calculating, black-clad bounty hunter Sabata, who foils a $100,000 bank heist in Daugherty. Allied with an agile acrobat and an eccentric banjo-carrying gunman (William Berger) who conceals a rifle inside his instrument, Sabata blackmails the corrupt town leaders who masterminded the robbery.

title: Sabata the Killer
alt_titles: Reza por Tu Alma... Y Muere
synopsis: Young Peter (Peter Lee Lawrence) double-crosses an unscrupulous banker (Eduardo Fajardo) by stealing $300,000 in cash. He escapes with the assistance of two traveling rogues, Sabata and Mangusta (Anthony Steffen and Alfredo Mayo), who arrive in town driving a modern motor car. When professional killers hunt them down, the breezy comedy takes a violent, grotesque turn.

title: Saguaro
synopsis: Peplum muscleman Kirk Morris stars as Jeff, an embittered Confederate veteran wandering through the southwest. When Mexican bandits ambush his party and murder his closest companion, Jeff assumes the identity of a territorial marshal and robs a local bank to finance his private vigilante army to eradicate the outlaws.

title: Sartana
alt_titles: If You Meet Sartana... Pray for Your Death
Se Incontri Sartana Prega per la Tua Morte
synopsis: Gianni Garko introduces the legendary archetype of Sartana, the immaculate, cloak-wearing 'Angel of Death'. After an army gold coach is ambushed by bandits and wiped out with a Gatling gun, Sartana manipulates the double-crossing conspirators—including a corrupt banker, a greedy widow, and rival bounty hunters (Klaus Kinski)—into destroying each other.

title: Sartana Does Not Forgive
synopsis: A somber revenge western blending the Sartana name with a classic family tragedy. When a ruthless outlaw crew led by Kirchner (Gilbert Roland) tortures and murders a young homesteader and his wife, the victim's vengeful brother, Sartana (George Martin), tracks the gang across the desert to execute them one by one.

title: Sartana in the Valley of Death
synopsis: William Berger stars as Lee Calloway (called Sartana in international prints), a mercenary hired to break three criminal brothers out of prison in exchange for half of their hidden gold cache. The brothers betray him after escaping, leaving him for dead in the desert until an enigmatic woman nurses him back to health.

title: Sartana Kills Them All
alt_titles: Lo Irritarono... e Sartana Fece Piazza Pulita
synopsis: An unofficial entry in the series starring Gianni Garko as Sartana. The vigilante arrives in a frontier outpost to investigate a heavily armed smuggling ring that has been raiding military depots and trafficking weapons to outlaws, utilizing cunning traps, ambushes, and trick weapons to clear out the syndicate.

title: Savage Gringo
synopsis: A wandering cowboy named Nebraska (Ken Clark) takes employment at a sprawling ranch owned by a tyrannical cattleman (Alfonso Rojas) who is widely hated throughout the valley. Nebraska finds himself caught in a deadly trap orchestrated by the rancher's unfaithful wife and her lover when the local sheriff is assassinated.

title: Savage Guns
synopsis: Considered one of the earliest modern precursors to the Spaghetti Western boom, filmed in the deserts of Spain. A weary American gunfighter (Richard Basehart) attempts to renounce violence while living in Sonora, Mexico. When an arrogant land baron (Fernando Rey) slaughters his host's family, the gunslinger takes up his weapons to lead a bloody resistance.

title: Savage Pampas
synopsis: Set in the rugged Argentine pampas during the late 19th century. Robert Taylor stars as an army captain tasked with escorting a wagon train of unruly women across desolate terrain to a remote frontier garrison to prevent mutiny among the soldiers, while fending off attacks from renegade deserters and hostile native forces.

title: Scalps
synopsis: One of the most graphic, brutal Eurowesterns ever made, directed by exploitation specialist Bruno Mattei. When an unhinged Confederate colonel (Albert Farley) orders the massacre of an entire Comanche village after the chief refuses to surrender his daughter, the surviving woman and an outcast tracker launch a savage, gory crusade of vengeance.

title: Secret of Captain O'Hara
synopsis: Captain Richard O'Hara (German Cobos) leads a cavalry detachment that rescues a woman from a native ambush. Escorting her to Fort San Antonio to meet her fiancé, O'Hara clashes with the garrison commander, a ruthless officer intent on inciting an all-out Indian war to clear land for speculators.

title: Seven Dollars on the Red
synopsis: Anthony Steffen stars as Johnny, an embittered frontiersman who spends fifteen years relentlessly tracking down El Chacal (Fernando Sancho), the sadistic bandit chieftain who murdered his wife and abducted his infant son. The search culminates in a massive, brutal street battle and an intense physical brawl inside a slaughterhouse.

title: Seven for Pancho Villa
synopsis: Following a disastrous military engagement, wounded revolutionary general Pancho Villa (Ricardo Palacios) is rescued and hidden by a loyal band of supporters. Joined by a sympathetic American adventurer (John Ericson), the small band conducts guerrilla raids against government forces to reignite the revolution.

title: Seven Guns for the MacGregors
synopsis: A lively, highly successful western following the Scottish-American MacGregor clan living on a sprawling ranch. When a vicious Mexican outlaw gang commanded by Miguel (Fernando Sancho) steals their prized horse herd and savings, the seven brothers unite to infiltrate the bandit stronghold and retrieve their stolen property.

title: Seven Guns for Timothy
synopsis: Sean Flynn (son of Errol Flynn) stars as a frontier mine manager who narrowly escapes a massacre orchestrated by a ruthless bandit gang led by Fernando Sancho. Seeking to reclaim the mine, he recruits a specialized team of convicts and mercenaries in a Magnificent Seven-style campaign.

title: Seven Guns from Texas
synopsis: A dramatic survival journey across the desert. An armed escort—including a former convict (Robert Hundar), a seasoned tracker, and a doctor—accompanies a gravely ill woman (Gloria Milland) to El Paso for emergency medical treatment, fighting off repeated ambushes by outlaws and native war parties along the route.

title: Seven Hours of Gunfire
synopsis: A multi-character frontier actioner bringing together legendary folk heroes Buffalo Bill (Rick Van Nutter), Wild Bill Hickok (Adrian Hoven), and Calamity Jane (Gloria Milland). The trio joins forces to broker a peace treaty between indigenous chiefs and frontier pioneers before a rogue attack sparks open war.

title: Seven Nuns in Kansas City
synopsis: An eccentric slapstick farce about two bumbling prospectors who stumble upon a rich gold vein after a wagon crash. When their claim is invaded by outlaws and regional bandits, the pursuit spills into a peaceful frontier convent, where the resident nuns take up kitchenware and tools to defend their grounds.

title: Seven Pistols for a Gringo
synopsis: Framed for the murder of a professional card player by a corrupt town boss (Albert Farley), a young traveler named Dan (Dan Harrison) goes into hiding inside the covered wagon of an eccentric traveling dentist. Biding his time, Dan methodically uncovers the evidence needed to clear his name in a final street shootout.

title: Shadow of Sartana... Shadow of Your Death
alt_titles: Meet the Sign of the Cross
Passa Sartana... È l'Ombra della Tua Morte
synopsis: Bounty hunter Sartana (Jeff Cameron) is targeted with a $10,000 price on his head by corrupt authorities. Seeking amnesty, he accepts an offer from territorial politicians to eliminate the vicious Randal brothers and an outlaw gang terrorizing the border. Notably features director Demofilo Fidani acting on-screen as a talkative mayor.

title: Shadow of Zorro
synopsis: In 1830s Spanish California, Don José (Frank Latimore) secretly adopts the mask and cape of El Zorro to protect the impoverished citizenry of San Pueblo from an extortionist bandit crew led by the ruthless Chinto (Raf Baldassare), who operates with impunity due to corrupt local officials.

title: Shalako
synopsis: Sean Connery plays Shalako, a seasoned frontier scout who encounters an aristocratic safari of wealthy European tourists hunting big game in Apache territory. When their double-crossing guide (Stephen Boyd) abandons them, Shalako must shepherd the helpless aristocrats through hostile desert terrain, culminating in a hand-to-hand fight with an Apache warrior (Woody Strode).

title: Shango
synopsis: Texas Ranger Shango (Anthony Steffen) rides into a frontier town dominated by a rogue Confederate officer (Eduardo Fajardo) who refuses to accept the South's surrender. Teaming up with a local bandit gang to locate buried gold, the tyrant finds his empire challenged when Shango launches an undercover campaign to free the oppressed citizens.

title: Sheriff of Rock Spring
synopsis: A seasoned gunfighter (Richard Harrison) hangs up his weapons and retires to the peaceful community of Rock Spring, where the grateful citizens appoint him town sheriff. His hopes for a tranquil life are ruined when a crooked banker conspires with saloon outlaws to violently seize regional property.

title: Sheriff Was a Lady
alt_titles: Freddy und das Lied der Prärie
synopsis: A colorful German-produced musical western. German pop idol Freddy Quinn plays a naive-seeming young man hunting down the bandit gang (led by Rik Battaglia) responsible for slaying his parents. Teaming up with a glamorous saloon entertainer (American bombshell Mamie Van Doren), they hatch a scheme to install her as sheriff to trap the killers.

title: Sheriff with the Gold
synopsis: When a notorious bandit is scheduled for execution, a corrupt federal marshal steps in with forged documents to stay the hanging. The rescue turns out to be part of the lawman's elaborate plan to force the prisoner to guide him to a buried cache of stolen gold bars.

title: Sheriff Won't Shoot
synopsis: Peplum bodybuilder Mickey Hargitay stars as a pacifist frontier sheriff who has long avoided lethal gunplay. His peaceful resolve is shattered when he discovers that his reckless younger brother has fallen in with an aggressive outlaw outfit, forcing the lawman into a final showdown to save his family.

title: Shoot, Gringo... Shoot!
music: Sante Maria Romitelli (as Richard Ira Silver)
synopsis: A famous gunman named Stark (Brian Kelly) is hired by a wealthy Mexican landowner to retrieve his wayward son, who has joined an outlaw gang led by a former Union officer (Keenan Wynn). After bringing the youth back, Stark is horrified to discover the father intends to crucify the boy over an infidelity accusation, prompting the gunslinger to intervene.

title: Shoot Joe, and Shoot Again
alt_titles: Joe Dakota, Spara... e Così Sia
synopsis: Richard Harrison stars as Joe Dakota, an undercover operative hunting down an elusive outlaw gang that stole a fortune in gold coins. Captured and tortured by the bandits, Joe miraculously survives to settle the score during an explosive final shootout at their mountain hideout.

title: Shoot the Living... Pray for the Dead
alt_titles: Pray to Kill and Return Alive
Prega per il Morto e Ammazza il Vivo
synopsis: Following a successful $100,000 bank heist in Phoenix, an outlaw gang hole up at an isolated border waystation. Tensions and power struggles erupt between gang leaders (Klaus Kinski and Dean Stratford), while an apparently innocent trail guide (Paul Sullivan) secretly bides his time to avenge his murdered parents.

title: Shoot to Kill
synopsis: An early Spanish-Italian co-production centering on an intense romantic rivalry. A dedicated ranch foreman (Edmund Purdom) falls in love with his employer's daughter (Silvia Solar), but finds his courtship contested by the rancher's outlaw nephew (Frank Latimore), culminating in a fiery battle inside a burning barn.

title: Shotgun
alt_titles: La Vendetta È il Mio Perdono
synopsis: American actor Tab Hunter plays Sheriff Durango, whose quiet retirement plans are ruined when four masked marauders slaughter his fiancée and her family. Spiraling into despair, Durango is pulled together by a compassionate saloon owner (Erika Blanc) and uncovers that respected town businessmen were behind the raid.

title: Shots Ring Out!
alt_titles: Si Udirono Quattro Colpi di Fucile
synopsis: A murder-mystery western where a female wanderer is convicted of slaying a local man. When her brother, gunfighter Frank Dalton (Paul Piaget), arrives in town, key witnesses and jury members are systematically assassinated, forcing the town sheriff to uncover the true killer before a lynch mob acts.

title: Showdown for a Badman
alt_titles: Per una Bara Piena di Dollari
synopsis: Bounty hunters Nevada (Hunt Powers) and his unnamed companion (Jeff Cameron) team up to dismantle an outlaw outfit commanded by the sadistic Hagen (Gordon Mitchell). Known for its energetic ensemble cast including Klaus Kinski and stylized cinematography by Aristide Massaccesi.

title: Sign of Coyote
synopsis: A lively adventure patterned on the Zorro myth. In 19th-century Spanish California, an agile masked vigilante known as Coyote (Fernand Canova) relies on pistols, traps, and disguises to frustrate an oppressive provincial governor and protect local peasants from unjust taxes.

title: Sign of Zorro
synopsis: Sean Flynn portrays Don Ramon, who returns to his ancestral home in colonial Mexico to discover his father assassinated by an illegitimate dictator. Donning a black mask and cape, Ramon becomes Zorro, leading a grassroots underground resistance against the tyrant's troops.

title: Silver Saddle
alt_titles: They Died with Their Boots On
music: Franco Bixio / Fabio Frizzi / Vince Tempera
synopsis: Lucio Fulci directs an emotional, beautifully crafted late-era western. After killing his father's murderer as a boy, Roy Blood (Giuliano Gemma) grows up to become a legendary bounty hunter. When a job goes wrong, Roy rescues an orphaned child related to his sworn enemies, protecting the youth from a sadistic gang of kidnappers.

title: A Sky Full of Stars for a Roof
alt_titles: . . .E per Tetto un Cielo di Stelle
synopsis: A breezy, episodic buddy adventure from Giulio Petroni. Giuliano Gemma and Mario Adorf star as two mismatched vagabonds—a nimble gunfighter and a lumbering drifter—who tumble into a series of comedic scrapes involving traveling circuses, card cheats, and pursuing outlaws.

title: Sometimes Life Is Hard, Right Providence?
alt_titles: La Vita, a Volte, È Molto Dura, Vero Provvidenza?
synopsis: Tomás Milian plays Providence, an eccentric, bowler-hatted, umbrella-wielding bounty hunter patterned after Charlie Chaplin. Teaming up with a brutish outlaw named Hurricane Kid (Gregg Palmer), Providence repeatedly turns his partner in for rewards, springs him from jail, and moves on to the next town to repeat the scam.

title: Son of a Gunfighter
synopsis: Russ Tamblyn stars as Johnny, a fast-drawing avenger pursuing an elusive outlaw named Ketchum (James Philbrook), the man who killed his mother. When he finally corners his quarry, Johnny discovers Ketchum is his biological father, leading them to unite to protect a Mexican hacienda from raiding bandits.

title: Son of Django
synopsis: Years after watching his father (the legendary Django) murdered by an outlaw cartel, grown son Clint (Gabriele Tinti) rides into Topeka City seeking retribution against town boss Clay. A traveling preacher and former gunfighter (Guy Madison) steps in to mentor Clint and help him dismantle the gang.

title: Son of Zorro
synopsis: A lighthearted action-comedy teaming Alberto Dell'Acqua as a dashing, masked folk hero alongside Fernando Sancho as his boisterous Mexican companion, combining acrobatic stunt work and gunfire to overthrow a regional tyrant.

title: Specialists
synopsis: Sergio Corbucci's satirical take on late-60s counterculture. French rock icon Johnny Hallyday stars as Hud, a chainmail-vested gunfighter who rides into the corrupt town of Blackstone to investigate his brother's lynching, contending with a sanctimonious elite, greedy bankers, and an unruly commune of young hippies.

title: Sting of the West
synopsis: An energetic frontier comedy inspired by classic madcap ensemble capers. A fraudulent frontier preacher named Father Jackleg (Jack Palance) and an eccentric swindler (Lionel Stander) attempt to sell off a worthless mine deed, only to discover the claim is genuinely loaded with gold, triggering a frantic scramble.

title: Stranger and the Gunfighter
alt_titles: Là, Dove non Batte il Sole
synopsis: A wild kung-fu western co-production. A master safecracker (Lee Van Cleef) and a Chinese martial artist (Lo Lieh) team up to locate a hidden imperial treasure. The clues to the fortune's whereabouts have been tattooed onto the backsides of four different women, sparking a frantic chase across the frontier.

title: Stranger in Japan
synopsis: The third entry in Tony Anthony's 'Stranger' cycle. The poncho-clad American gunfighter journeys to feudal Japan to deliver a sacred scroll for a $20,000 reward. Finding himself caught between rival samurai clans battling over regional control, the Stranger relies on his four-barreled shotgun to survive.

title: Stranger in Paso Bravo
synopsis: Anthony Steffen stars as Gary, a quiet drifter who arrives in the border settlement of Paso Bravo seeking retribution for the murder of his wife and child. Despite facing public humiliation and torture from an authoritarian cattle baron (Eduardo Fajardo), Gary takes up his Winchester to settle the score.

title: Stranger in Sacramento
synopsis: Bodybuilder Mickey Hargitay stars as Mike Jordan, an honest California rancher who returns home to find his family slaughtered and their livestock stolen by rustlers. When corrupt local officials refuse to investigate, Mike tracks the predatory land baron responsible across the Sacramento Valley.

title: Stranger in Town
alt_titles: For a Dollar in the Teeth
synopsis: The film that launched Tony Anthony's iconic 'Stranger' character. A lone, poncho-clad opportunist arrives in an abandoned outpost seized by a Mexican bandit crew led by Aguilar (Frank Wolff). After helping the outlaws ambush a military gold convoy, the Stranger is betrayed and beaten, returning to reclaim the loot.

title: Stranger Returns
alt_titles: Un Uomo, un Cavallo, una Pistola
synopsis: Tony Anthony returns as the witty, pragmatic Stranger. Armed with his signature four-barrel pistol, he pursues a murderous bandit gang led by En Plein (Dan Vadis) that has hijacked a stagecoach. Discovering the carriage itself is constructed of solid gold, the Stranger methodically outwits the thieves.

title: Stranger That Kneels Beside the Shadow of a Corpse
alt_titles: Inginocchiati Straniero... i Cadaveri non Fanno Ombra
synopsis: Boasting one of the most poetic titles in Italian cult cinema, this surreal outing follows a quiet bounty hunter (Hunt Powers) being tracked across the desert by a mysterious adversary (Chet Davis). The two men cross paths in an oppressed mining outpost controlled by a tyrannical boss (Gordon Mitchell).

title: Sugar Colt
synopsis: A unique blend of espionage and frontier action. Undercover agent Tom Cooper, known as Sugar Colt, is dispatched to investigate the sudden disappearance of 130 Union soldiers. Disguising himself as an eccentric doctor in Snake Valley, he uncovers an extortion conspiracy orchestrated by a corrupt syndicate.

title: Sunscorched
alt_titles: Jessy Does Not Forgive... He Kills!
synopsis: Former outlaw turned sheriff Jess Kinley (Mark Stevens) finds his town taken hostage by his old gang, led by the sadistic Abel Dragna (Mario Adorf). Blackmailed by his former comrades who threaten to expose his past, the lawman is pushed to the limit when the gang attacks the community church.

title: Take a Hard Ride
alt_titles: La Parola di un Fuorilegge... È Legge!
synopsis: Following the death of their employer, two loyal ranch hands (Jim Brown and Fred Williamson) undertake a perilous trek across Mexico to deliver $86,000 in livestock profits to the man's family. They are pursued by a cold-blooded bounty hunter named Kiefer (Lee Van Cleef) and rival gangs of mercenaries.

title: Talent for Loving
synopsis: An eccentric western comedy based on a Richard Condon novel. Richard Widmark plays a notorious gambler who journeys into Mexico to claim an inherited estate, becoming entangled with a decadent local aristocrat (Cesar Romero) who believes his family is afflicted by an ancient Aztec curse.

title: Tall Women
synopsis: When an Apache war party massacres a frontier wagon train, seven surviving women take refuge inside a mountain cave. Led by a resolute pioneer (Academy Award-winner Anne Baxter), the unarmed women navigate the desert wilderness and native warriors to reach safety.

title: Taste for Killing
synopsis: Craig Hill stars as Lanky Fellow, a calculating bounty hunter who tails money convoys, allowing bandits to raid them so he can eliminate the robbers and collect rewards from the bank. When an Omaha banker wagers a double bounty, Lanky takes on a bandit outfit commanded by Fernando Sancho.

title: Taste of Violence
synopsis: An early French-produced precursor to the Spaghetti Western cycle. A revolutionary leader (Robert Hossein) kidnaps the daughter of a Latin American dictator to hold her as political collateral, only for romantic bonds and moral dilemmas to complicate their survival trek through the mountains.

title: Ten Thousand Dollars Blood Money
synopsis: Gianni Garko plays Django, a mercenary bounty hunter who refuses to accept any contract paying under $10,000. When an escaped Mexican outlaw (Claudio Camaso) abducts the daughter of a wealthy land baron and murders Django's lover, the manhunter embarks on a vicious vendetta.

title: Tequila
alt_titles: Uno, Dos, Tres... Dispara Otra Vez
synopsis: Anthony Steffen plays a deadpan gunfighter teamed with an eccentric, bumbling sidekick named Fuzzy (Roberto Camardiel). Arriving in a frontier outpost controlled by a corrupt town boss (Eduardo Fajardo), the duo uses quick-draw gunplay and slapstick antics to dismantle the extortion syndicate.

title: Terrible Sheriff
synopsis: A madcap early Spanish-Italian western farce. Two cowardly brothers (Walter Chiari and Raimondo Vianello) accidentally consume a rooster treated with an experimental super-strength formula. Becoming fearless gunslingers, they are appointed dual town marshals to rid Golden City of an elusive masked bandit.

title: Terror of Oklahoma
synopsis: One of the earliest Italian-produced frontier comedies, directed by screenwriter Mario Amendola. A bumbling greenhorn sheriff attempts to bring order to an unruly boomtown, relying on slapstick good fortune to outmaneuver frontier outlaws.

title: Terror of the Black Mask
synopsis: Cult director Umberto Lenzi helms this masked adventure set in 17th-century Spanish California. Pierre Brice stars as Don Diego, an unassuming nobleman who secretly dons a black mask and cape to champion the cause of oppressed peasants against an autocratic military governor.

title: Tex and the Lord of the Deep
alt_titles: Tex e il Signore degli Abissi
synopsis: Based on the iconic Italian comic series by Gianluigi Bonelli. Giuliano Gemma stars as Texas Ranger Tex Willer, investigating a mysterious arms-smuggling ring supplying weapons to Yaqui warriors. He uncovers an ancient occult threat involving green mystical rocks capable of mummifying victims.

title: Texas, Adios
synopsis: Sheriff Burt Sullivan (Franco Nero) takes a leave of absence to travel to Mexico with his younger brother to avenge their father's murder by ruthless land baron Cisco Delgado. During the showdown, a scandalous family secret regarding his brother's true parentage threatens to tear their mission apart.

title: Texican
synopsis: Decorated war hero Audie Murphy stars as Jess Carlin, an ex-lawman living in exile across the Mexican border. When he receives word that his newspaper-publisher brother was assassinated by a corrupt frontier town boss (Broderick Crawford), Carlin returns to Texas to clear his name and take down the syndicate.

title: They Call Him Cemetery
alt_titles: His Pistols Smoked... They Call Him Cemetery
Gli Fumavano le Colt... lo Chiamavano Camposanto
synopsis: Gianni Garko plays the laconic, lethal bounty hunter known as Cemetery. Arriving in a frontier outpost, he assists two pacifist rancher brothers being terrorized and extorted by a predatory land baron named Duke (William Berger), culminating in a meticulously executed town shootout.

title: They Call Him Veritas
synopsis: Mark Damon stars as Veritas, an educated, smooth-talking frontier con artist who uses a handbook on how to get rich to orchestrate elaborate swindles with his companions. The gang successfully steals a stash of gold from outlaws, only to be outsmarted by the author of the very book they study.

title: They Call Me Trinity
synopsis: The comedy that revolutionized the genre. The lazy, dust-caked drifter Trinity (Terence Hill) visits his horse-thief brother Bambino (Bud Spencer), who is masquerading as the sheriff of a quiet valley. The duo reluctantly bands together to defend a peaceful community of Mormon settlers against an aggressive cattle baron.

title: They Called Him Trinity
synopsis: A low-budget vengeance thriller directed by Luigi Batzella. A lone gunfighter relentlessly tracks down the masked bandits who murdered his sister, only to discover the secret mastermind behind the gang is none other than his own brother-in-law.

title: They Still Call Me Amen
alt_titles: Mamma Mia È Arrivato Così Sia
synopsis: A broad, slapstick sequel to A Man Called Amen. Rogue gunslinger Horacio (Luc Merenda) and his double-crossing partner (Alfio Caltabiano) continue their chaotic search across the frontier to recover their stolen loot from an elusive schoolteacher who swindled them.

title: Thirteenth Is a Judas
synopsis: A gritty whodunit western where a seasoned former lawman turned bounty hunter (Donald O'Brien) arrives in an isolated territory to track down a sadistic, elusive serial killer known as the 'Monster of the Prairie'.

title: Thirty Winchesters for El Diablo
synopsis: Cowboy Jeff Benson (Carl Möhner) is hired by a rancher to safely escort a massive herd across territory contested by the ruthless Mexican rustler El Diablo. After outsmarting the bandits, Benson leads an armed resistance aboard a gold train to eliminate the gang for good.

title: This Man Can't Die
synopsis: Guy Madison stars as Martin Benson, a federal agent who returns home to find his parents slaughtered and his sister traumatized by a corrupt town boss (Rik Battaglia). Joining forces with his younger brother, Benson launches a calculated, cold-blooded manhunt.

title: Thompson 1880
synopsis: A mysterious drifter named Raymond Thompson (George Martin) arrives in Desert Spring to challenge the despotic rule of casino owner Blackie. Left for dead after a severe beating, Thompson recovers and straps on a custom rapid-fire prototype machine gun to wipe out the cartel.

title: Those Dirty Dogs!
synopsis: A lively, action-packed military caper. Three cavalry soldiers led by Chadwell (Stephen Boyd) are dispatched to Texas to quell an uprising by Mexican revolutionaries, teaming up with an eccentric bounty hunter named Korano (Gianni Garko) who uses specialized gadgets and trick rifles.

title: Three Bullets for a Long Gun
alt_titles: Friss den Staub von meinen Stiefeln
synopsis: A rare South African-produced western. A Yankee gunfighter (Beau Brummell) and a Mexican bandit form an uneasy partnership to uncover a massive cache of hidden Confederate gold, but their mutual greed quickly devolves into a deadly duel across rugged terrain.

title: Three from Colorado
synopsis: Retired bounty hunter George Martin attempts to establish a quiet horse ranch with his family in Laramie. When an extortionist cattle baron and his gunmen attempt to drive them off their land, the gunfighter is forced to unearth his weapons to defend his home.

title: Three Graves for a Winchester
alt_titles: Tre Colpi di Winchester per Ringo
synopsis: A dark, low-budget vengeance entry pairing bodybuilder Mickey Hargitay with cult heavy Gordon Mitchell. A lone gunman seeks retribution against the outlaw gang that terrorized his frontier community, leading to a series of ambushes and cave shootouts.

title: Three Musketeers of the West
alt_titles: Tutti per Uno, Botte per Tutti
synopsis: A comedic frontier adaptation of the classic Dumas novel. A bumbling greenhorn (Timothy Brent) joins three eccentric Texas Rangers escorting a secret operative (Karin Schubert) into revolutionary Mexico, battling outlaws to a quirky, eclectic musical score.

title: Three Silver Dollars
alt_titles: I Protect Myself Against My Enemies
synopsis: A dying soldier gives a cowboy (Charles Southwood) a carved silver dollar, revealing that three such coins together mark the coordinates to a hidden treasure. The cowboy pursues the remaining coins, facing off against an outlaw chieftain (Julian Mateos) whose final gunshot defaces the coins forever.

title: Three Supermen of the West
alt_titles: ...E Così Divennero i 3 Supermen del West
synopsis: A superhero fantasy crossover where three acrobatic, bulletproof heroes in tights and red capes are transported back in time to the 1890s American frontier. Recruited by federal marshals, the trio uses slapstick combat and acrobatics to thwart bandit chieftain Cucho (Fernando Sancho).

title: Three Swords of Zorro
synopsis: In 1830s California, the legendary masked vigilante Zorro mentors his adult son and daughter in swordsmanship and guerrilla tactics so they can help defend local peasants from an authoritarian regional governor and his troops.

title: Thunder Over El Paso
synopsis: Antonio Sabàto stars as Minnesota, a black-clad bounty hunter stripped of his earnings by a ruthless Mexican bandit chief. Minnesota forms an alliance with a young outlaw to infiltrate the bandit's fortified compound and reclaim the stolen gold.

title: Time and Place for Killing
alt_titles: And Then a Time for Killing
synopsis: A grim, methodical western following a determined frontier marshal (Anthony Ghidra) who defies legal orders and crosses the border into Mexico to track down the notorious bandit gang responsible for murdering his sister.

title: Time of Vultures
synopsis: When an agile vaquero named Kitosch (George Hilton) is beaten and branded by his cruel cattle-baron employer, he flees to join an outlaw band led by a psychopathic killer (Frank Wolff). Horrified by the gang's sadism, Kitosch turns against them to defend his former home.

title: To Hell and Back
synopsis: George Hilton stars as a relentless avenger whose family was massacred during an armed ranch raid. He embarks on an obsessive pursuit of the ruthless outlaw leader (Gerard Herter) responsible, resulting in a cold-blooded trail of executions across the borderlands.

title: Today It's Me... Tomorrow You
alt_titles: Oggi a Me... Domani a Te
synopsis: Scripted by Dario Argento. Wrongfully convicted of his wife's murder by a sadistic bandit (Japanese cinema star Tatsuya Nakadai), an innocent man is released from prison and spends his fortune hiring four specialized gunfighters (including Bud Spencer and William Berger) to enact his revenge.

title: Too Much Gold for One Gringo
alt_titles: They Believed He Was No Saint
Lo Credevano uno Stinco di Santo
synopsis: Bandit leader Rojas (Fernando Sancho) raids a Mexican chapel and steals the hollowed-out statue of a patron saint containing a fortune in gold. A wandering American gunfighter (Anthony Steffen) uncovers the secret and wages a solitary campaign to intercept the treasure.

title: Torrejon City
synopsis: An early Spanish frontier comedy starring Tony Le Blanc as an inept, accidental sheriff who attempts to enforce the law in an unruly boomtown, relying on slapstick good fortune to outsmart a gang of cattle thieves.

title: Town Called Hell
synopsis: A brutal, existential British-Spanish production. A former Mexican revolutionary turned disillusioned priest (Robert Shaw) hides in a decaying border settlement ruled by a sadistic warlord (Telly Savalas), while a vengeful widow (Stella Stevens) and an army officer (Martin Landau) arrive to settle old blood debts.

title: Trail of the Falcon
