synopsis: An East German 'Red Western' presenting the frontier conflict from the indigenous perspective. Yugoslavian athletic star Gojko Mitic portrays Dakota chief Falke, who leads his warriors in a desperate struggle to defend sacred tribal lands against corrupt gold prospectors and speculative rail tycoons.

title: Train for Durango
synopsis: A lively adventure caper following two American rogues (Anthony Steffen and Mark Damon) who steal the keys to a secure train safe. When Mexican revolutionaries rob the train, the duo tracks down the guerrillas and an eccentric European aristocrat to claim a share of the gold.

title: Tramplers
synopsis: Joseph Cotten plays an authoritarian Confederate patriarch who refuses to accept the Civil War's end, waging a private war of terror against incoming settlers. His sons (Gordon Scott and James Mitchum) are forced to turn against their father to stop the slaughter. Notable as Franco Nero's genre debut.

title: Treasure of Silver Lake
synopsis: The historic German production that launched the Eurowestern craze. Frontier scout Old Shatterhand (Lex Barker) and Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice) track an unprincipled gang of outlaws led by Colonel Brinkley (Herbert Lom), who murdered a stagecoach passenger to seize a map leading to an ancient tribal gold cache.

title: Treasure of the Aztecs
synopsis: Part one of Robert Siodmak's lavish historical epic based on Karl May. Dr. Karl Sternau (Lex Barker) travels to 1860s Mexico on a diplomatic mission for President Lincoln, becoming entangled in the Mexican civil war and a dangerous quest to safeguard a legendary Aztec treasure from French mercenaries.

title: Trinity and Sartana Are Coming
alt_titles: Trinity and Sartana... Those Dirty S.O.B.s
Trinità e Sartana: Figli di... Dio
synopsis: A lowbrow comedy capitalizing on two major genre franchises. A black adventurer named Trinity (Harry Baird) and a bumbling bandit named Sartana (Alberto Dell'Acqua) bungle an attempted bank heist and inadvertently become folk heroes when they liberate a town from an oppressive outlaw gang.

title: Trinity Is Still My Name
synopsis: The smash-hit official sequel to They Call Me Trinity. Brothers Trinity and Bambino promise their dying father they will become successful outlaws, but their soft-hearted natures repeatedly ruin their criminal plans as they inadvertently foil an arms-smuggling ring operating out of a frontier monastery.

title: Trinity Plus the Clown and a Guitar
alt_titles: Prima Ti Suono e Poi Ti Sparo
synopsis: George Hilton stars as Trinity, a wandering gunfighter who travels the frontier accompanied by an agile circus acrobat and a traveling minstrel (Piero Lulli). The trio rides into an isolated border settlement and uses comedic combat and trickery to liberate the townspeople from a marauding bandit gang.

title: Trinity Sees Red
synopsis: A politically charged drama starring Terence Hill as Marco, an aimless gunfighter hired by an aristocratic Spanish landowner (Fernando Rey) to assassinate union organizers. Witnessing the brutal oppression of the peasant laborers, the gunman shifts his allegiance and leads a violent agrarian revolt.

title: Twenty Paces to Death
synopsis: Saranda (Dean Reed), a native orphan raised by a frontier mayor, falls in love with his guardian's daughter. Exiled from the settlement due to racial prejudice, Saranda returns to defend the community when he uncovers a treacherous plot by a corrupt senator to seize the town's gold mines.

title: Twenty Thousand Dollars for Seven
synopsis: A rare and obscure 1968 actioner starring Brett Halsey as a seasoned gunfighter hired to locate and rescue an abducted frontier child held for ransom by a notorious Mexican bandit gang led by Fernando Sancho.

title: Twice a Judas
synopsis: Antonio Sabàto stars as Luke, a gunfighter suffering from total amnesia after an assassination attempt. Returning to his family estate, he is manipulated by an unscrupulous land baron (Klaus Kinski), gradually recovering his memories to uncover the horrifying truth about who betrayed him.

title: Twins from Texas
synopsis: A frontier slapstick comedy featuring the Italian comedy duo Walter Chiari and Raimondo Vianello as two bumbling, identical twin brothers separated at birth who unwittingly swap identities in a lawless border town, confusing local marshals and outlaw gangs.

title: Two Crosses at Danger Pass
synopsis: When a corrupt outlaw gang murders a frontier sheriff and his family, the only survivor—a young boy—grows up to become a lethal marksman known as The Kid (Peter Martell). Armed with a custom rifle, he returns to Danger Pass to systematically hunt down and execute each killer.

title: Two Gangsters in the Wild West
alt_titles: Two Mafiamen in the Far West
synopsis: Franco and Ciccio play two Sicilian convicts who inherit a lucrative Texas gold mine from their murdered cousins. Escaping to America, the inept pair stumble through encounters with Mexican bandits (Fernando Sancho), native tribes, and scheming saloon con-artists.

title: Two Gunmen
synopsis: Texas Ranger Robert Logan (Alan Scott) is ordered to arrest his childhood friend Cassidy (George Martin) on false murder charges. When the two discover that a ruthless female ranch boss (Susy Andersen) framed Cassidy to seize his land, they join forces to expose the syndicate.

title: Two Pistols and a Coward
synopsis: Gary McGuire (Anthony Steffen) is a brilliant trick-shooter in a traveling circus who is privately paralyzed by cowardice. When a town bully murders his friends and threatens an orphaned boy, Gary overcomes his fear, transforming into a ruthless avenger.

title: Two R-R-Ringos from Texas
synopsis: Franco and Ciccio star as two delicate city dandies from Baltimore who travel west to take possession of an inherited Texas ranch, bumbling their way through shootouts with Mexican bandits and romancing glamorous dancehall performers.

title: Two Sergeants of General Custer
synopsis: In this Civil War military comedy, Franco and Ciccio play two inept soldiers who accidentally infiltrate the Confederate lines as undercover scouts, running into hilarious complications with an alluring female spy (Margaret Lee) and Mexican bandidos.

title: Two Sides of the Dollar
synopsis: A meticulous heist drama. A brilliant intellectual nicknamed Matematica (Maurice Poli) orchestrates an intricate robbery of a military payroll safe inside a fortified Union outpost, but greed and betrayal among his criminal partners turn the escape into a bloody disaster.

title: Two Sons of Ringo
synopsis: Franco and Ciccio play two petty swindlers pretending to be the heirs of legendary gunfighter Ringo to claim a $100,000 inheritance. Their scheme backfires when the will stipulates they must first hunt down and execute Ringo's fiercest enemy, the ruthless bandit Indio.

title: Two Sons of Trinity
synopsis: A late-cycle comedy parodying the Trinity series. Franco and Ciccio star as two clumsy frontiersmen who inherit an isolated property and stumble into an escalating conflict with local cattle rustlers and a corrupt saloon syndicate.

title: Two Thousand Dollars for Coyote
synopsis: James Philbrook stars as the masked freedom fighter Coyote, operating in colonial California to defend small farmers and villagers against an authoritarian provincial governor and his corrupt military tax collectors.

title: Ugly Ones
synopsis: Tomás Milian makes his genre debut in this acclaimed psychological western based on Marvin H. Albert's novel Bounty Killer. Milian plays José Gomez, an escaped Mexican outlaw sheltered by the good citizens of his hometown who remember him as a boy. Professional bounty hunter Luke Chilson (Richard Wyler) tracks him down, forcing the townspeople and Gomez's lover (Ella Karin) to recognize the outlaw's ruthless, cold-blooded transformation.

title: Up the MacGregors!
synopsis: A lighter, family-oriented sequel to Seven Guns for the MacGregors. The Scottish MacGregor brothers and their sweethearts join forces once again to track down and recover their stolen savings from a band of opportunistic Mexican outlaws across the border.

title: Valley of the Dancing Widows
synopsis: A satirical European western adaptation of Aristophanes' Lysistrata. When the men of a Texas frontier town return home after fighting in the American Civil War, they discover their wives have taken control of the municipality and instituted an organized sex strike to protest violence and militarism.

title: Vendetta at Dawn
alt_titles: Terrible Day of the Big Gundown
Quel Maledetto Giorno della Resa dei Conti
synopsis: A violent, horror-tinged revenge western. Dr. George Benton (George Eastman) returns to Culver City from medical school, only to find the region overrun by ruthless outlaws. When a gang of sadistic cutthroats massacres his family, the physician abandons his peaceful Hippocratic oath to execute cold-blooded retribution.

title: Vengeance
synopsis: Richard Harrison stars as Joko, a gunfighter who discovers his close friend drawn and quartered by rival outlaws over a cache of gold. Taking the five severed rope pieces from the crime, Joko vows to return one to each of the responsible killers, culminating in a gothic, fog-shrouded cemetery confrontation.

title: Vengeance Is a Dish Served Cold
alt_titles: Vengeance Is a Dish Eaten Cold
La Vendetta È un Piatto Che Si Serve Freddo
synopsis: Traumatized after witnessing his family slaughtered during what appeared to be an Indian raid, Jeremiah Bridger (Leonard Mann) becomes a ruthless native-hunter. Along the way, he uncovers that the attack was actually staged by a corrupt land baron (Ivan Rassimov) employing hired mercenaries in disguise. Co-stars Klaus Kinski as an opportunistic journalist.

title: Viva Cangaceiro
synopsis: Set during the 1920s bandit uprisings in the arid scrublands of northeastern Brazil. Tomás Milian stars as Miguelin, an outlaw leader hailed as a folk hero by impoverished rural peasants. A corrupt military commandant (Eduardo Fajardo) hires a foreign mercenary to eliminate him before he can stage a regional rebellion.

title: Viva Maria
synopsis: Louis Malle directs this lavish adventure comedy set in 1910 Mexico. Two traveling music-hall performers named Maria (Brigitte Bardot and Jeanne Moreau) inadvertently invent the striptease during a circus act. When their troupe visits San Miguel, the women join forces with a handsome rebel leader (George Hamilton) to lead an armed revolution against a brutal dictator.

title: Wanted
synopsis: A stylish, classic western where Giuliano Gemma stars as framed sheriff Gary Ryan. Wrongfully accused of murder by an influential syndicate of horse rustlers and local officials, Ryan escapes custody and goes undercover to expose the actual criminal mastermind (Serge Marquand).

title: Wanted Johnny Texas
synopsis: A bizarre, visually discordant frontier actioner shot in Florence. Johnny Texas (James Newman) is recruited by the military to guide a wagon train loaded with munitions through territory held by an unhinged bandit gang, leading to an explosive siege against a desert fortress.

title: Wanted Sabata
synopsis: Brad Harris plays a lone-wolf gunman operating as an undercover vigilante in a corrupt border town. He methodically tracks an elusive outlaw ring while unmasking a syndicate of municipal officials pulling the strings behind local stage robberies.

title: Watch Out Gringo! Sabata Will Return
synopsis: George Martin leads an ensemble cast in a tangled border dispute involving stolen Mexican gold, crooked town bosses, and bandit raids. Despite the title and international promotional materials, the character of Sabata never actually appears in the narrative.

title: What Am I Doing in the Middle of the Revolution?
alt_titles: Che C'Entriamo Noi con la Rivoluzione?
synopsis: Two traveling Italian vaudeville actors (Vittorio Gassman and Paolo Villaggio) wander into Mexico seeking a fortune to finance their passage home. Caught in the chaos of the 1910 Revolution, one actor is mistaken for rebel leader Emiliano Zapata, sparking accidental heroics against an authoritarian government.

title: White Apache
synopsis: An exploitation western directed by Bruno Mattei. An orphaned white child raised by Apaches grows up to become the warrior Shining Sky (Sebastian Harrison). When he leaves the tribe, he encounters racism and cruelty from a sadistic local gang, culminating in a brutal and tragic frontier confrontation.

title: White Comanche
synopsis: William Shatner stars in a dual role as twin half-breed brothers: Johnny Moon, a peace-seeking cowboy, and Garvin, a psychopathic peyote-addicted Comanche war leader. The sibling rivalry boils over into an all-out battle for control of the border town of Rio Hondo. Co-stars Joseph Cotten.

title: White, the Yellow, and the Black
alt_titles: Il Bianco, il Giallo, il Nero
synopsis: Sergio Corbucci's final western is a broad, colorful frontier farce. A dapper Swiss gunfighter (Giuliano Gemma), a clumsy Japanese martial artist (Tomás Milian), and an escaped bandit (Eli Wallach) form an uneasy trio searching for a priceless sacred horse stolen by renegade cavalry deserters.

title: Who Killed Johnny R.?
alt_titles: 5000 Dollar für den Kopf von Johnny Ringo
synopsis: German cinema icon Lex Barker stars as an unassuming traveling gun salesman named Dillon. Arriving in a frontier territory, he is mistakenly identified as notorious fugitive outlaw Johnny Ringo and faces imminent lynching until his companion helps him prove his identity.

title: Who's Afraid of Zorro
alt_titles: Ah Sì? E Io lo Dico a Zzzzorro!
synopsis: A comedic take on the Zorro legend starring George Hilton as a clumsy, reluctant freedom fighter whose heroics in colonial California are secretly orchestrated and guided by a clever Catholic monk (Lionel Stander) working behind the scenes.

title: Winchester Does Not Forgive
synopsis: American singer Dean Reed stars as Buckaroo, a quiet horse trainer who takes employment on a remote ranch. In reality, he is a calculating avenger intent on exposing the wealthy rancher (Livio Lorenzon) who assassinated his father years earlier over a silver claim.

title: Winnetou: Last of the Renegades
synopsis: Frontier scout Old Shatterhand (Lex Barker) and Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice) strive to prevent an all-out war when a renegade gang of oil prospectors attacks a pioneer convoy and attempts to frame peaceful native tribes. Features early genre appearances by Terence Hill and Klaus Kinski.

title: Winnetou: The Desperado Trail
synopsis: The dramatic third installment of the German Karl May franchise. Old Shatterhand (Lex Barker) and Winnetou (Pierre Brice) struggle against ruthless land speculators who attempt to poison settler relations. The film features the dramatic and unexpected sacrifice of Chief Winnetou.

title: Winnetou: Thunder at the Border
alt_titles: Winnetou und sein Freund Old Firehand
synopsis: Veteran American actor Rod Cameron takes on the role of frontier trapper Old Firehand. Alongside Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice), he helps fortify and defend a vulnerable border town from an impending siege by a large, heavily armed outlaw outfit.

title: Winnetou and Shatterhand in the Valley of Death
alt_titles: Winnetou und Shatterhand im Tal der Toten
synopsis: Lex Barker and Pierre Brice reunite for this adventure where Old Shatterhand and Winnetou defend the honor of an army officer falsely accused of embezzling military funds, escorting the man's daughter through hostile territory to recover the hidden treasure.

title: Winnetou the Warrior
synopsis: The foundational entry in the European Winnetou series. Railroad surveyor Old Shatterhand (Lex Barker) turns against his corrupt employers after discovering they violated tribal treaties to steal sacred gold, earning the eternal blood-brotherhood of young Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice).

title: With Friends, Nothing Is Easy
alt_titles: Alla Larga Amigos... Oggi Ho il Grilletto Facile
synopsis: Bounty hunter Scott (Richard Harrison) agrees to assist a young woman in breaking her three outlaw uncles out of a corrupt Mexican penitentiary run by Colonel Jimenez (Fernando Sancho), secretly intending to collect the bounties on all three once they cross back into Texas.

title: Woman for Ringo
synopsis: A musical western vehicle crafted for popular Spanish twin pop duo Pili and Mili. The sisters play traveling trick-shot performers who inherit a deed to a frontier ranch, teaming up with their neighbors (including Sean Flynn) to thwart a corrupt banker plotting to steal the property.

title: Wrath of God
alt_titles: Hasta la Última Gota de Sangre
synopsis: Returning home to discover his ranch torched, his fiancée murdered, and his money stolen, a vengeful gunfighter (Brett Halsey) tracks down each perpetrator, leaving a single silver dollar on each corpse as a calling card, culminating in a duel against his former best friend.

title: Yankee
synopsis: Cult director Tinto Brass crafts a highly stylized, Pop-Art-influenced western. Philippe Leroy plays Yankee, a solitary drifter who arrives in the Mexican town of Pueblo to challenge the territory's brutal bandit boss, Cobra (Adolfo Celi), turning the outlaw outfit against one another for profit.

title: Yankee Dudler
synopsis: An unconventional, contemplative German-Spanish frontier drama following a family of Bavarian immigrant woodcutters attempting to build a peaceful homestead in the lawless West. Co-stars Geraldine Chaplin as Kate Elder alongside William Berger as Doc Holliday.

title: You're Jinxed, Friend, You Just Met Sacramento
alt_titles: Sei Iettato Amico, Hai Incontrato Sacramento
synopsis: Ty Hardin plays Jack 'Sacramento' Thompson, a peaceful rancher forced into a deadly feud with a tyrannical local town boss. When the boss retaliates by kidnapping Sacramento's children, the quiet cowboy wages a ruthless, one-man siege to rescue them.

title: Zorro
synopsis: Alain Delon stars as Don Diego, an agile adventurer who assumes the identity of his murdered friend, the incoming governor of Nuova Aragona. Posing as a foppish, cowardly official by day, he dons the black cape and mask of Zorro by night to lead the oppressed citizenry in a revolt against a tyrannical military colonel (Stanley Baker).

title: Zorro, Rider of Vengeance
synopsis: Guided by an enigmatic spiritual entity, the masked avenger Zorro returns to colonial California to dismantle an occult criminal syndicate known as the Brotherhood of the Scorpion, who have assassinated his close friend and abducted his bride.

title: Zorro, the Navarra Marquis
synopsis: A European costume-action adventure featuring Zorro operating in 19th-century Spain. Dispatched by the exiled King Ferdinand VII, the masked hero conducts guerrilla sabotage operations against occupying French military forces commanded by a sadistic colonel (Daniele Vargas).

title: Bad Kids of the West
director: Mario Amendola, Bruno Corbucci, Tonino Ricci (as Tony Good)
synopsis: Two wanted outlaws seeking shelter in what appears to be a deserted ghost town discover it is entirely inhabited and governed by children who bizarrely emulate adult behavior and vice. The film descends into surreal and absurd slapstick gags as the young townsfolk outwit the bewildered intruders. Directed under a collective pseudonym by three genre veterans.

title: Bad Man's River
alt_titles: E Continuavano a Fregarsi il Milione di Dollari
synopsis: A chaotic action comedy revolving around eccentric bank robber Bomba (Lee Van Cleef), who marries a conniving con-woman (Gina Lollobrigida) only to be swindled and locked in an asylum. After escaping, Bomba and his partners are recruited by a riverboat captain (James Mason) to obliterate an arsenal for a million-dollar payday, leading to an endless round of double-crosses along the Mexican border.

title: Ballad of a Gunman
alt_titles: Ringo, Pray to Your God and Die
synopsis: Two distinct gunmen track the ruthless Mexican outlaw El Bedoja. One is a calculating bounty hunter seeking a lucrative cash reward, while the other is an innocent man framed by the bandit fifteen years prior, driven entirely by a desire to clear his name and exact revenge for his murdered father.

title: Bandera Bandits
alt_titles: Banda J & S, Cronaca Criminale del Far West
synopsis: A western reimagining of the Bonnie and Clyde narrative. Escaped Mexican bandit Jed (Tomás Milian) finds himself teamed with an unconventional, free-spirited wanderer named Sonny (Susan George) as they rob their way across the borderlands while being pursued by a vengeful lawman (Telly Savalas).

title: Bandidos
synopsis: After a sadistic gunslinger shoots his hands to ruin his career, a former trick-shot marksman establishes a traveling circus act. Along the way, he takes a framed fugitive under his wing, training him in lethal marksmanship to hunt down the outlaw gang responsible for his maiming. Renowned for its stylish cinematography by former Leone cameraman Massimo Dallamano.

title: Bang Bang Kid
synopsis: A quirky sci-fi-infused frontier farce where an eccentric inventor creates an automated mechanical gunfighter to liberate a mining town from an oppressive industrial baron (Guy Madison). Highlights include Tom Bosley as the bewildered inventor facing off against traditional western heavies.

title: Bastard, Go and Kill
synopsis: George Eastman stars as a peaceful frontiersman who is pushed over the edge when a detachment of rogue soldiers ravages his homestead and murders his entire family. Driven by fury, he tracks the perpetrators across the territory with relentless brutality, aided by stark camera work by Aristide Massaccesi.

title: Beast
synopsis: Klaus Kinski plays the depraved outlaw Machete, a vicious criminal terrorizing the frontier while leaving a trail of assault and destruction in his wake. Known for Kinski's eccentric wardrobe choices and unhinged performance.

title: Behind the Mask of Zorro
synopsis: In 19th-century Spanish California, the masked champion of the oppressed works undercover as a mild-mannered servant inside the governor's estate to protect regional officials from an insurgent warlord plotting a violent uprising.

title: Belle Starr Story
alt_titles: Il Mio Corpo per un Poker
synopsis: A rare female-led Eurowestern scripted and directed by famed auteur Lina Wertmüller under an alias. Elsa Martinelli stars as the legendary frontier outlaw Belle Starr, who leverages her lethal pistol skills, gambling prowess, and sexuality to hold her own among violent bandits and deceitful partners.

title: Ben and Charlie
alt_titles: Amico, Stammi Lontano Almeno un Palmo
synopsis: A comedy-tinged buddy adventure chronicling the misadventures of two small-time rogues who wander into Desert City. After being wrongly imprisoned by a crooked sheriff seeking to pin local robberies on them, they orchestrate an escape to clear their records and retrieve the missing loot.

title: Between God, the Devil and a Winchester
alt_titles: God Was in the West, Too, at One Time
Anche nel West, C'era una Volta Dio
synopsis: A Treasure Island-style adventure transposed to the frontier, revolving around a sacred church treasure stolen during the Civil War. A rogue priest and a masked gunfighter independently employ the skills of a wilderness tracker to recover the hidden hoard before a rival gang reaches it.

title: Beyond the Law
synopsis: Lee Van Cleef delivers an atypical performance as Cudilip, an aging con man and bandit who is unexpectedly handed the sheriff's badge of a mining outpost. As he learns the value of civic duty, he must choose between his criminal past and defending the townspeople against former associates planning a massive payroll raid.

title: Big Gundown
synopsis: Widely considered a pinnacle of the genre outside Leone's trilogy. Veteran lawman Jonathan Corbett (Lee Van Cleef) is hired by an aspiring railroad tycoon to capture Cuchillo (Tomás Milian), a peasant accused of an atrocity. The chase across Mexico reveals the true nature of corruption and morality, culminating in an iconic duel sequence in a cane field.

title: Big Ripoff
synopsis: A nihilistic caper about a gang of outlaws who seize an abandoned, disease-ridden town as their base to ambush a military gold convoy. Internal greed, mutual distrust, and shifting loyalties lead to mutual destruction among the participants.

title: Big Showdown
synopsis: A mystery-laden western where an exiled sheriff (Lee Van Cleef) shields a young man wrongfully accused of killing a patriarch, facing down bounty hunters and three corrupt brothers to unravel who actually pulled the trigger.

title: Billy the Kid
synopsis: An early Spanish entry dramatizing the conflict between Pat Garrett and Billy the Kid, presenting an episodic and revised interpretation of the legendary outlaw's rise and subsequent confrontation with the law.

title: Black Eagle of Santa Fe
alt_titles: Die Schwarzen Adler von Santa Fe
synopsis: A German-Italian co-production centering on an undercover government agent dispatched to New Mexico to investigate sudden Indian uprisings. He discovers a greedy land baron orchestrating raids disguised as native attacks in order to drive settlers out.

title: Black Jack
synopsis: A dark, amoral outing where Robert Woods stars as a ruthless outlaw leader who absconds with the entire haul of a Tucson bank robbery. Betrayed and targeted by his abandoned comrades and an allied native tracker, a brutal cycle of retaliation ensues.

title: Black Killer
synopsis: A town dominated by seven murderous brothers and a crooked judge sees its lawmen systematically executed. A vengeful brother pins on the badge to seek retribution for his murdered family, assisted by a mysterious lawyer in black (Klaus Kinski) who hides weapons inside leather-bound legal tomes.

title: Black Tigress
synopsis: American singer-actress Lola Falana stars as a saloon entertainer who arrives in a lawless border territory and uses her wits and influence to uncover clues to a concealed fortune while resisting local thugs.

title: Blindman
synopsis: Inspired by Japanese Zatoichi films, Tony Anthony stars as a visually impaired sharpshooter hired to transport fifty mail-order brides. When they are kidnapped by Mexican bandidos led by Domingo and his brother Candy (Ringo Starr), the blind gunslinger relentlessly tracks them down with dynamite and a walking-stick shotgun.

title: Blood and Guns
synopsis: A politically charged historical western detailing the struggle between peasant revolutionary Tepepa (Tomás Milian) and a cold, autocratic military colonel played by Orson Welles, examining the compromises and moral costs of armed insurrection.

title: Blood at Sundown
director: José Antonio De La Loma / Edward Muller
synopsis: Anthony Steffen plays an army deserter who returns home determined to find the killers who crippled him, uncovering a web of local greed orchestrated by his fiancee's ruthless father.

title: Blood at Sundown (Reissue)
alt_titles: One Thousand Dollars on the Black
synopsis: A dramatic sibling rivalry where an innocent brother returns from unjust imprisonment to discover his sociopathic brother (Gianni Garko, in a pre-hero Sartana role) has terrorized the region and claimed his former lover.

title: Blood Calls to Blood
synopsis: A vicious bandit chieftain steals a sacred gem from a monastery, executing the monks inside. The brother of one of the victims vows retribution, launching a relentless pursuit of the outlaw gang across the arid frontier.

title: Blood for a Silver Dollar
synopsis: A discharged Confederate soldier travels west to build a new life, but is tricked by a town boss into a gunfight against his own brother. Saved from death when a bullet strikes a silver dollar in his pocket, he goes undercover to bring down the syndicate.

title: Blood River
alt_titles: Dieci Bianchi Uccisi da un Piccolo Indiano
synopsis: A very late-cycle, moody Eurowestern boasting an eclectic international ensemble including Julie Newmar and John Ireland, focusing on revenge, cross-country survival, and racial confrontations on the edge of the frontier.

title: Boldest Job in the West
alt_titles: El Más Fabuloso Golpe del Far West
synopsis: A gang of multinational outlaws executes an elaborate and supposedly bloodless heist on a major frontier bank, but the plan implodes when an insider betrays the squad and steals the entire haul for himself.

title: Boot Hill
synopsis: The concluding entry in the Colizzi trilogy uniting Terence Hill and Bud Spencer. Wounded gunfighter Cat Stevens is sheltered by a traveling circus troupe, eventually recruiting trapeze acrobats and hard-hitting allies to liberate a mining settlement from a corrupt claim-jumper (Victor Buono).

title: Born to Kill
synopsis: Typically known for villainous roles, Gordon Mitchell plays a stoic gunfighter who rides into an oppressed town and is persuaded by local citizens and a saloon hostess (Femi Benussi) to confront the land baron running the county.

title: Bounty Hunter in Trinity
synopsis: A professional manhunter is hired by town leaders to rid the settlement of an outlaw ring, only to discover the conspiracy runs straight to the town's prominent saloon proprietor. Directed and photographed by Joe D'Amato.

title: Brother Outlaw
alt_titles: Rimase Uno Solo e Fu la Morte per Tutti
synopsis: When a young man is wrongfully imprisoned for an armed holdup, his brother engineers a prison break. The pair spend the remainder of the story hunting down the actual bandits and the mastermind behind the scheme.

title: Brothers Blue
alt_titles: Blu Gang Vissero per Sempre Felici e Ammazzati
synopsis: A moody, stylistic western influenced by the rapid pace of late-60s American outlaw cinema. Jack Palance plays an uncompromising lawman obsessed with tracking down the elusive and doomed Blue brother bandit gang.

title: Buddy Goes West
synopsis: A late-career comedy vehicle for Bud Spencer, who plays a traveling brawler mistaken for a licensed physician in a remote settlement. With his indigenous sidekick, he uses his physical might to defend the community against land-grabbers.

title: Buffalo Bill, Hero of the Far West
alt_titles: Buffalo Bill, l'Eroe del Far West
synopsis: Bodybuilding star Gordon Scott portrays Buffalo Bill, tasked by the government with entering hostile territory to identify arms traffickers selling rifles to dissident tribes and preserve regional peace treaties.

title: Bullet for Sandoval
alt_titles: Quei Disperati Che Puzzano di Sudore e di Morte
synopsis: A Confederate deserter seeks vengeance against his aristocratic former landlord (Ernest Borgnine) after his family dies of illness through neglect. Complications arise when the deserter falls for his adversary's daughter.

title: Bullet for the General
synopsis: A landmark political Eurowestern. A mercenary joins a charismatic Mexican rebel leader's outfit on an ideological and financial train raid, secretly harboring a contract from the government to assassinate the general.

title: Bullets and the Flesh
synopsis: A frontier drama transposing classic family feud tropes. A timber baron attempts to burn down native forest preserves to secure lumber contracts for the railroad, triggering an armed uprising.

title: Bullets Don't Argue
synopsis: A dedicated sheriff has his wedding interrupted by a daring bank raid. He pursues the two bandit brothers across the Mexican border, but faces a gang of mercenaries attempting to hijack the recovered funds on the return journey.

title: Bury Them Deep
alt_titles: To the Last Drop of Blood
synopsis: A military payroll shipment is ambushed by an outlaw outfit. A hired tracker rescues the ringleader's imprisoned brother from the gallows to help track down the gang and recover the army gold.

title: Calibre .38
alt_titles: E alla Fine lo Chiamavano Jerusalem l'Implacabile
synopsis: Jerusalem Wade (Scott Holden, son of William Holden) is a benevolent gunfighter and occasional bounty hunter who rides into town to protect his sister from an overbearing land baron (Keenan Wynn). A notable curiosity as the only directorial effort by acclaimed cinematographer Toni Secchi. Features solid genre support from Mimmo Palmara and Philippe Leroy.

title: California
synopsis: A somber, gritty post-Civil War drama starring Giuliano Gemma as an ex-Confederate soldier drifting through Missouri. After delivering the belongings of an executed comrade to the soldier's family, he falls for the sister (Malisa Longo) and stays to work their land. When ruthless bounty hunters slaughter the family and kidnap the woman, California launches a brutal pursuit. Grittily photographed in earthy tones by Alejandro Ulloa.

title: Canadian Wilderness
synopsis: A frontier survival adventure focused on the hardships faced by early pioneers carving out lives in the rugged northern wilderness. The settlers must band together to withstand harsh natural elements, hostile native factions, and opportunistic outlaw raiders. Directed by Spanish cult horror figure Armando De Ossorio.

title: Captain Apache
synopsis: Lee Van Cleef plays a Native American cavalry officer assigned to solve the mysterious murder of an Indian Commissioner whose dying words were 'April Morning.' His investigation leads him into a complex web of land speculation, corrupt politicians, and a plot by a rogue renegade (Stuart Whitman) to assassinate President Grant. The film is notorious for Van Cleef personally crooning the eccentric theme song.

title: Carambola
synopsis: An action-heavy comedy modeled directly on the Terence Hill/Bud Spencer formula, featuring lookalike duo Paul Smith and Michael Coby. After breaking out of prison, the two con-men wander into Desert City and stumble onto an illegal arms-smuggling ring run by a crooked town boss. Features comic brawls, disguise gags, and an unexpected martial arts showdown inside a hall of mirrors.

title: Carambola's Philosophy: In the Right Pocket
synopsis: The sequel to Carambola, following the same rogue pair as they hustle local frontier towns for quick cash. While heavyweight Lynn takes bets on brute tests of strength, partner Coby cleans up at the saloon pool tables through trick-shot trickery. Trouble arises when they target the wrong local syndicate and end up having to shoot their way out.

title: Cavalry Charge
alt_titles: La Carga de la Policia Montada
synopsis: An early Spanish-produced western that follows a mounted patrol stationed along a volatile border zone. Tasked with protecting pioneer outposts, the cavalrymen find themselves caught between regional bandits and escalating tensions with local tribes. Features music by frequent Jess Franco collaborator Daniel White.

title: Cemetery Without Crosses
synopsis: A bleak, minimalist masterpiece cowritten by Dario Argento and directed by star Robert Hossein. When a woman's husband is lynched by a ruthless ranching dynasty, she hires a reclusive gunfighter living in a ghost town to execute an intricate plan of psychological and violent retribution. Sergio Leone famously makes a cameo appearance as a hotel clerk.

title: Challenge of the Mackennas
synopsis: A drifter (Robert Woods) seeking to escape his violent past wanders directly into a deadly borderland range war between two tyrannical ranch owners (John Ireland and Roberto Camardiel). Forced to choose a side to protect innocent families caught in the crossfire, he takes up arms in a bloody campaign of self-defense.

title: Charge of the Seventh Cavalry
synopsis: Set in 1863, Confederate forces attempt to send an envoy into Mexico to negotiate military assistance from Emperor Maximilian. When their expedition is intercepted at Wichita Pass by the Union Seventh Cavalry, a Confederate scout must rely on assistance from friendly tribes to turn the tide in a large-scale battle.

title: Charley One-Eye
synopsis: An unconventional, allegorical western pairing an African-American Union deserter (Richard Roundtree) with a crippled, outcast Indian (Roy Thinnes). Taking refuge inside a desolate abandoned church in the desert, the two form an uneasy bond of survival until a ruthless bounty hunter (Nigel Davenport) tracks them down.

title: Chetan, Indian Boy
synopsis: A rare, melancholic German 'anti-western' focusing on the tender, bittersweet relationship between an aging homesteader and an orphaned native youth who helps him work his isolated ranch. Photographed by celebrated cinematographer Michael Ballhaus, the film prioritizes realism and atmosphere over conventional shootouts.

title: China 9, Liberty 37
synopsis: Railroad barons rescue a condemned gunfighter (Fabio Testi) from the gallows on the condition that he murder a defiant homesteader (Warren Oates) who refuses to yield his property. Instead, the gunman befriends the farmer and has an illicit affair with the man's wife (Jenny Agutter), leading to a shared stand against the railroad syndicate. Features a rare acting cameo by director Sam Peckinpah.

title: Chino
synopsis: Charles Bronson stars as Chino Valdez, a solitary halfbreed horse breeder in the American Southwest who wants nothing more than to be left in peace. When he begins a romance with the sister of a wealthy, bigoted cattle baron (Marcel Bozzuffi), the rancher subjects Chino to brutal beatings and destroys his homestead, forcing Chino into an act of tragic defiance.

title: Christmas Kid
synopsis: When rich mineral deposits are discovered in Jasper, Arizona, the quiet community quickly descends into lawlessness, gambling, and corruption. Jeffrey Hunter plays the Christmas Kid, a gunman initially hired by the corrupt town boss who switches allegiance and becomes marshal after his lover is murdered during a turf dispute.

title: Chrysanthemums for a Bunch of Swine
alt_titles: Crisantemi per un Branco di Carogne
synopsis: An outlaw gang attacks a rural wedding, slaughtering guests and abducting the young bride to an abandoned monastery. A mysterious, sharpshooting friar (Edmund Purdom) takes up weapons to track the kidnappers down and liberate the captive. An offbeat genre rarity from director Sergio Pastore.

title: Chuck Moll
synopsis: An amnesiac gunfighter escaping from an asylum is manipulated by a deceptive former confederate who claims to be his father, aiming to weaponize him against an old business partner. As his memory slowly returns, Chuck discovers the horrifying truth about who murdered his real family. Directed by Trinity creator Enzo Barboni before his shift to pure comedy.

title: Ciccio Forgives, I Don't
synopsis: A slapstick parody poking fun at Giuseppe Colizzi's hit film God Forgives, I Don't. Lowbrow comedy legends Franco and Ciccio play two bumbling insurance salesmen who make the terrible mistake of trying to sell life and accident policies to violent bandidos, chief among them the notorious El Pantera (Fernando Sancho).

title: Cipolla Colt
synopsis: Franco Nero plays Onion Stark, an eccentric marksman whose sole obsession is buying land to farm sweet onions. When a corrupt oil syndicate led by a ruthless tycoon with a mechanical hand (Martin Balsam) attempts to drive him out, Stark retaliates using a bizarre assortment of customized weaponry, onion juice, and slapstick acrobatics.

title: Cisco
synopsis: When a border sheriff leaves town, his corrupt deputy joins forces with an outlaw gang to plunder the regional bank. Cisco (William Berger), a cunning loner with a bounty on his head, stays one step ahead of both sides by taking the money first and staging his own death to expose the dishonest lawmen.

title: Cjamango
synopsis: After winning a massive cache of gold in a high-stakes poker game, gunfighter Cjamango is ambushed and robbed by two rival bandit factions led by El Tigre and Don Pablo. When El Tigre kidnaps a young boy to blackmail the hero, Cjamango tracks down both outfits in a relentless war of attrition.

title: Clint the Stranger
synopsis: Rancher Clint Harrison is sentenced to prison after killing two hired hands in self-defense during an aggressive land dispute. Years later, he returns home to find his homestead abandoned and his family missing, sparking a search that brings him into direct conflict with the region's tyrannical cattle baron.

title: Coffin for the Sheriff
synopsis: Anthony Steffen plays a former lawman who infiltrates a merciless bandit crew led by the treacherous Murdock (Eduardo Fajardo). Blaming the gang for the murder of his wife, the disguised sheriff acts as an inside operative until he can turn the outlaws against one another in a final town standoff.

title: Colorado Charlie
synopsis: A frontier marshal resigns his post to start a quiet family life, leaving law enforcement in the hands of his youthful deputy. When a vicious outlaw known as Colorado Charlie raids the town and shoots the new lawman, the retired marshal straps on his twin Colts to hunt the gang down.

title: Colt 45, Five Dollars, and a Bandit
synopsis: An obscure, low-budget Italian-Spanish production that received minimal theatrical release outside southern Europe. The story follows a lone gunfighter navigating small frontier mining communities to capture an elusive bandit ring for a cash bounty.

title: Colt in the Hand of the Devil (1967)
alt_titles: An Angel with a Gun Is a Devil
Una Colt in Pugno del Diavolo
synopsis: A military scout sent into the Mojave Desert to locate a missing wagon train discovers the settlers have been enslaved by a charismatic outlaw boss operating an illegal mine. The scout forms an unexpected camaraderie with the bandit leader before the cavalry arrives to force a final decision.

title: Colt in the Hand of the Devil (1972)
alt_titles: Una Colt in Mano del Diavolo
synopsis: Texas Ranger Wilton (Robert Woods) is tasked with tracking down the elusive and sadistic Butch Brown gang (headed by William Berger). Setting up traps across desert hideouts, the ranger methodically hunts down each gang member while safeguarding a local widow caught in the conflict.

title: Colt Is the Law
synopsis: Two undercover federal marshals are dispatched to San Felipe to investigate the disappearance of railroad construction payrolls. Discovering that prominent local businessmen are behind the thefts, the lawmen discard subtle detective work in favor of continuous, high-octane gun battles.

title: Comin' at Ya!
synopsis: A landmark 3-D western produced and starring Tony Anthony. A bumbling bank robber decides to settle down and marry his sweetheart (Victoria Abril), but ruthless outlaws invade the church and abduct her. The groom mounts an obsessive chase across the borderlands, utilizing a sawed-off shotgun and flaming arrows to annihilate the kidnappers.

title: Compañeros
synopsis: Corbucci's political adventure masterpiece set during the Mexican Revolution. A sharp, cynical Swedish arms merchant (Franco Nero) and a fiery peasant rebel (Tomás Milian) form an uneasy alliance to liberate an idealistic pacifist professor (Fernando Rey) from a military prison to unlock a safe full of revolutionary funds, all while being hunted by a marijuana-smoking mercenary (Jack Palance).

title: Cost of Dying
synopsis: A snowbound mountain western set in Colorado, where a vicious band of cattle rustlers takes over a freezing frontier settlement. When an elderly retired sheriff and his stepson are gunned down trying to resist the takeover, the townspeople band together in a unique shootout staged amidst deep snowdrifts.

title: Cowards Don't Pray
synopsis: A grim psychological revenge tale. A veteran returns from the Civil War to find his homestead burned and his wife murdered by vigilantes. Consumed by hatred, he becomes a psychopathic bandit, eventually forcing his former friends and family to hunt him down when his thirst for violence spirals out of control.

title: Coyote
synopsis: Mexican cinema favorite Abel Salazar plays the masked avenger Coyote, defending the oppressed citizens of 1840s California against the tyrannical abuses of an autocrat governor and his corrupt military garrisons.

title: Cry for Revenge
synopsis: Two bounty hunters (Mark Damon and Anthony Steffen) agree to help a widow avenge her husband's murder by an elusive outlaw outfit. Full of classic genre double-crosses, tense quick-draw confrontations, and a twisting trail of betrayals.

title: Cut-Throats Nine
synopsis: Renowned as one of the most violent and gruesome westerns ever made. When a prison wagon overturns in a blizzard, a cavalry sergeant and his daughter must escort a chain gang of psychotic, condemned killers on foot through the snow. Paranoia, greed, and mutilation quickly escalate into an apocalyptic struggle for survival.

title: Dallas
alt_titles: Il Mio Nome è Scopone e Faccio Sempre Cappotto
synopsis: Anthony Steffen plays Jake, a reformed gunslinger who tries to hang up his pistols and live a quiet life in Dallas. His retirement is ruined when a notorious bounty hunter (Frank Braña) wanders into town, forcing him back into gunplay to defend his homestead. Directed by Spanish workhorse Ignacio Iquino under his Juan Bosch pseudonym.

title: Damned Pistols of Dallas
synopsis: An early Spanish co-production where a frontier sheriff (Fred Bier) must organize reluctant, terrified Dallas citizens to defend their town against an advancing Mexican army detachment while awaiting cavalry reinforcements. Features French actor Olivier Mathot in an early genre role.

title: Day of Anger
synopsis: A masterpiece of the genre exploring the student-and-mentor relationship. Cynical, aging gunfighter Frank Talby (Lee Van Cleef) arrives in Clifton and takes Scott Mary (Giuliano Gemma), an abused town street-sweeper, under his wing, teaching him ten ruthless rules of survival. When Talby takes over the town by extortion, Scott is forced to use those very lessons against his teacher in a tragic showdown.

title: Days of Violence
synopsis: Set in Missouri during the Civil War, two brothers find their farm torched and destroyed by Union soldiers. Seeking retribution, one brother joins a Confederate guerrilla outfit, only to discover the gang's leader is more interested in senseless robberies and bloodthirsty plunder than the Southern cause. Elevated by the presence of genre star Rosalba Neri.

title: Dead Are Countless
synopsis: A unique, dark psychological thriller with a serial killer motif. As a child, Johnny (Peter Lee Lawrence) witnessed his father's brutal execution by Union soldiers, leaving him so deeply traumatized that he now tracks and slaughters every military officer he encounters. Hardened federal officer Garringo (Anthony Steffen) is dispatched with orders to hunt the young madman down dead or alive.

title: Dead for a Dollar
alt_titles: Trusting Is Good... Shooting Is Better
Fidarsi è Bene, Sparare è Meglio
synopsis: A lighthearted caper comedy following three rival outlaws (George Hilton, John Ireland, and Piero Vida) who successfully execute a $200,000 bank robbery. The thieves spend the rest of the narrative double-crossing, tricking, and chasing each other across the border until an opportunistic saloon woman swindles the entire fortune from under their noses.

title: Dead Men Ride
synopsis: Escaped prisoner Roy Greenford (Fabio Testi) is nursed back to health by an impoverished Mexican peasant family. Seeing the local farmers brutalized and starved by greedy town boss Redfield (Eduardo Fajardo), Roy acts as an avenging angel to liberate their valley. Bruno Nicolai provides an explosive soundtrack heavily echoing his work with Ennio Morricone.

title: Deadlock
synopsis: A sun-scorched, avant-garde contemporary German western filmed near the Dead Sea. A wounded bank robber carrying a suitcase packed with $700,000 collapses in a desolate desert outpost, where an opportunistic vagrant (Mario Adorf) and a ruthless partner (Anthony Dawson) battle over the buried money in a minimalist, feverish standoff punctuated by a krautrock score.

title: Deadly Trackers
synopsis: A traditional wagon-train drama starring Richard Harrison as a seasoned scout hired to escort homesteaders through treacherous, outlaw-infested territory in Wyoming. The plot takes a romantic turn when he falls for a Swedish traveler played by international screen siren Anita Ekberg.

title: Deaf Smith and Johnny Ears
synopsis: Anthony Quinn stars as the historical, hearing-impaired scout Erastus 'Deaf' Smith alongside his fast-talking partner Johnny Ears (Franco Nero). Sent on an undercover mission by Sam Houston to stop a corrupt general conspiring with foreign powers against Texas statehood, the duo uses dynamite, deception, and rifle skills to thwart the plot.

title: Death at Owell Rock
alt_titles: La Morte Non Conta i Dollari
synopsis: Veteran Italian horror filmmaker Riccardo Freda directs this stylish revenge mystery. Gunfighter Lawrence (Mark Damon) returns to the sinister settlement of Owell Rock to investigate the murder of his father, only to find the terrified residents cowed into silence by a wealthy land baron and his ruthless gunmen.

title: Death Is Sweet from the Soldier of God
alt_titles: Seminò la Morte... Lo Chiamavano il Castigo di Dio
synopsis: Brad Harris plays a mysterious wanderer in black—part ghost, part holy avenger—who arrives in a border territory to administer vigilante justice against an untouchable outlaw chieftain. Combining gothic overtones with bullet-riddled showdowns, this film was retitled Django Adios in several foreign markets.

title: Death Knows No Time
alt_titles: E Intorno a Lui Fu Morte
synopsis: A lone, nameless bounty hunter tracks an elusive outlaw known as the Cactus Kid into a violent border town. After wiping out the local gang of bandits, the stranger is persuaded by the desperate townspeople to pin on the sheriff's tin star and restore order to the region.

title: Death on High Mountain
synopsis: When a bumbling Mexican bandit general and a corrupt town boss stage an elaborate bank raid during a church wedding, two bystanders (Peter Lee Lawrence and Luis Dávila) shoot their way into the robbery and hijack the loot for themselves, sparking a series of double-crosses and mountain chases.

title: Death Played the Flute
alt_titles: Lo Ammazzo Come un Cane... Ma Lui Rideva Ancora
synopsis: Riffing on Charles Bronson's iconic harmonica-playing gunfighter, Michael Forrest stars as Ryan, an eccentric bounty hunter who carries a concert flute and plays melodic tunes before dispatching his targets. He takes on a corrupt gang terrorizing homesteaders along the frontier.

title: Death Rides a Horse
synopsis: As a child, Bill (John Phillip Law) survived the brutal slaughter of his entire family by a gang of bandits. Fifteen years later, he teams up with newly released convict Ryan (Lee Van Cleef), who is also hunting the same men for framing him. Bill gradually discovers the horrifying truth: Ryan was among the gang on the night his family died. Highlighted by one of Ennio Morricone's greatest and most savage musical scores.

title: Death Rides Alone
synopsis: A textbook tale of single-minded frontier retribution. Young Bobby (Mike Marshall) spends years mastering the fast draw after his mother and sister are murdered by bandits. Armed and hardened, he embarks on an unrelenting hunt across the badlands until every member of the gang is dead.

title: Death Sentence
synopsis: A pure, stripped-down episodic vengeance western. Cash (Robin Clarke) tracks down the four men responsible for his brother's execution: an aging gambler (Richard Conte), an epileptic albino bandit (Tomás Milian in a bravura performance), a corrupt former priest (Enrico Maria Salerno), and an arrogant land baron (Adolfo Celi).

title: Death Walks in Laredo
synopsis: An outlandish, comic-book-inspired western. Three half-brothers—an American sharpshooter, a Japanese martial artist, and a French illusionist—inherit a gold mine in Laredo, only to find the territory ruled by an eccentric tyrant (Enrico Maria Salerno) who believes he is the reincarnation of Julius Caesar and rules from a hilltop Roman palace.

title: Deguello
synopsis: Following the Civil War, an outlaw crew led by Ramon (Dan Vadis) tortures a Confederate officer to reveal the location of a buried fortune, killing him and his men. The officer's son forms a posse of vengeful sharpshooters, tracking the gang down to an abandoned ghost town for a bullet-strewn standoff.

title: Deserter
synopsis: A gritty Dirty Dozen-style western starring Bekim Fehmiu as an embittered cavalry deserter recruited by a general (John Huston) to lead a specialized squad of cutthroats and misfits into an impregnable Apache mountain stronghold across the Mexican border.

title: Desperado
synopsis: A wandering, weary gunfighter rides into an oppressed agricultural territory and comes to the defense of a community of terrified homesteaders. He falls in love with a spirited widowed rancher (Malisa Longo) and takes up arms to wipe out the extortion syndicate terrorizing the valley.

title: Dick Luft in Sacramento
alt_titles: Di Tressette C'è Ne Uno... Tutti gli Altri son Nessuno
synopsis: A broad, farcical satire directed by the genre's most prolific director, Giuliano Carmineo. George Hilton stars as Dick Luft, an incompetent wanna-be gunslinger whose clever sidekick Veleno orchestrates every encounter from the shadows to make him look like a legendary dead-eye hero.

title: Dig Your Grave, Friend... Sabata's Coming
alt_titles: Not Sabata or Trinity... It's Sartana
Abre Tu Fosa, Amigo... Llega Sabata
synopsis: Steve McGowan (Richard Harrison) partners with a boisterous Mexican bandit (Fernando Sancho) to avenge his father's murder at the hands of a corrupt land baron. When the baron hires the ice-cold mercenary Sabata to wipe them out, an explosive, three-way tactical war erupts across the territory.

title: Django
synopsis: Corbucci's genre-defining masterpiece. Franco Nero stars as the iconic, mud-splattered gunslinger dragging a coffin through a godforsaken border town torn between sadistic ex-Confederates and Mexican revolutionaries. Armed with a portable machine gun, Django wages a one-man war of vengeance that culminates in an unforgettable showdown among cemetery headstones.

title: Django, a Bullet for You
synopsis: One of the very first unofficial Django follow-ups released just months after the original. James Philbrook plays the titular vigilante who intervenes to protect small homesteaders in Wagon Valley from a ruthless land baron (Aldo Berti) conspiring with corrupt railroad executives to forcibly seize the territory.

title: Django and Sartana Are Coming... It's the End
alt_titles: Django and Sartana... Showdown in the West
Sartana, If Your Left Arm Offends, Cut It Off
Arrivano Django e Sartana... È la Fine
synopsis: Cult hack director Demofilo Fidani pairs the two biggest names of the genre for an offbeat outing. Gordon Mitchell plays bandit leader Black Burt, who abducts a wealthy rancher's daughter. Bounty hunters Django (Hunt Powers) and Sartana (Chet Davis) track the gang across the Mexican border, only to clash over whether to claim the girl or the bounties on the dead bodies.

title: Django Challenges Sartana
synopsis: A well-lensed, fast-paced actioner featuring two iconic western archetypes on the trail of the same elusive bandit gang. Initially clashing over competing bounties and mutual suspicion, Django (Tony Kendall) and Sartana (Georges Ardisson) eventually join forces to wage an explosive final assault on the outlaws' fortified mountain redoubt.

title: Django Does Not Forgive
synopsis: A unique revenge western transposed to a harsh Canadian frontier backdrop. When a rogue Mountie rapes and murders his sister, Django (John Clark) embarks on an obsessive pursuit that plunges him into the middle of a raging territorial war between the army and local indigenous tribes.

title: Django, Kill... If You Live, Shoot!
synopsis: Regarded as the most surreal, violent, and gothic Eurowestern ever created. Tomás Milian stars as a half-breed gunman who claws his way out of a mass grave armed with gold bullets. He wanders into The Lears, a nightmarish town torn apart by greed, sadism, and a bizarre gang of black-clad outlaws led by a villain named Zorro (Roberto Camardiel).

title: Django Kills Softly
synopsis: Horror director Massimo Pupillo helms this hyper-violent textbook revenge thriller. George Eastman plays a brooding, phantom-like Django who rescues a woman from Mexican bandits, only to arrive in a frontier town where the entire hotel staff and guests have been massacred by a sadistic local boss and his unhinged brothers.

title: Django, Last Killer
synopsis: A desperate young Mexican farmer named Ramon (George Eastman) sees his parents slaughtered and his land stolen by a tyrannical land baron. Despondent, he crosses paths with legendary bounty hunter Django (Anthony Ghidra), who takes pity on the youth and trains him in the deadly art of pistol marksmanship for an inevitable showdown.

title: Django Shoots First
synopsis: Glenn Saxon steps into the role of Django, arriving in town to claim his inheritance from his murdered father, only to discover his former business partner Doc Gordon (Fernando Sancho) has usurped control of the town. Packed with fast-paced saloon brawls, shootouts, and an exceptional musical score by Bruno Nicolai.

title: Django Strikes Again
synopsis: The only official sequel to the 1966 original recognized by Sergio Corbucci and starring Franco Nero. Having lived in a secluded South American monastery for over a decade, Django is forced to dig up his buried machine gun from a grave when a tyrannical slaver (Christopher Connelly) kidnaps his young daughter.

title: Django the Bastard
synopsis: Widely cited as the uncredited inspiration for Clint Eastwood's High Plains Drifter. Anthony Steffen plays a spectral, black-clad avenger who appears from the shadows to execute the traitorous Confederate officers who massacred his battalion for gold years earlier, placing a cross marked with each man's name and hour of death before killing them.

title: Djurado
synopsis: Montgomery Clark plays a suave, unbeatable gambler nicknamed 'Golden Poker' who wins half-ownership of a border saloon. When the town is terrorized by a sadistic bandit chief named Tucan (Luis Induñi), the gambler relies on his concealed quick-draw talents and a local federal lawman to liberate the settlement.

title: Do Not Touch the White Woman
synopsis: A biting surrealist art-house political satire from provocateur Marco Ferreri. The film restages Custer's Last Stand as an allegorical conflict inside the modern construction crater of the Forum des Halles in downtown Paris, blending period cavalry costumes, bloody battle sequences, and contemporary high-rise urban development.

title: Dollar of Fire
synopsis: A frontier marshal (Michael Riva) arrives in the vice-ridden town of Jerrington to clean up rampant corruption and gambling syndicates. After shutting down a notorious brothel, he finds himself targeted by the mayor, only to discover the enigmatic woman running the crime ring is the wife who abandoned him years earlier.

title: Dollars for a Fast Gun
alt_titles: One Hundred Thousand Dollars for Lassiter
synopsis: A wheelchair-bound former bank robber turned ruthless land baron (José Bodalo) crushes local homesteaders with exorbitant taxes and hired muscle. Desperate, a widowed rancher hires a dapper gunfighter named Lassiter (Robert Hundar) to orchestrate an elaborate scheme that dismantles the baron's criminal enterprise.

title: Don't Turn the Other Cheek
synopsis: A lively comedic romp directed by Duccio Tessari set during the Mexican Revolution. A cynical Russian con artist prince (Franco Nero), an earthy peasant bandit (Eli Wallach), and an idealistic, fiery Irish revolutionary journalist (Lynn Redgrave) form a volatile partnership in search of hidden gold and political chaos.

title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
synopsis: Django (Ivan Rassimov) and his sidekick Diego are hired by a young woman to avenge her uncle's murder by a greedy land baron. The plot turns chaotic when a rival band of Mexican bandits hijacks the conflict, forcing Django into a vicious rescue mission to save the girl from execution.

title: Drummer of Vengeance
synopsis: A grim British-Italian co-production starring Ty Hardin as 'The Stranger', a traumatized wanderer who methodically hunts down and eliminates the six ruthless outlaws who raped and murdered his wife (Rosalba Neri) and child. Notable for its somber tone and an impressive lineup of genre regulars like Craig Hill and Gordon Mitchell.

title: Duck You Sucker
synopsis: Sergio Leone's grand, explosive epic of the Mexican Revolution. An IRA explosives expert on the run (James Coburn) crosses paths with an amoral Mexican bandit (Rod Steiger). What begins as an elaborate bank heist turns into an ideological awakening as both men are swept into the catastrophic violence of revolutionary warfare.

title: Duel at Sundown
synopsis: A classic German-backed drama featuring Terence Hill in an early role as Don McGow. He and his brother Larry (Peter Van Eyck) find themselves pitted against each other when Don falls in love with the daughter of a neighboring rancher targeted by their despotic land-grabbing father (Walter Barnes).

title: Duel in the Eclipse
synopsis: Peplum star Lang Jeffries plays a quiet rancher who seeks vengeance after his brother is tortured and murdered by bandidos. He infiltrates the gang, biding his time until a total solar eclipse provides the darkness needed to wage an eerie, cinematic final shootout.

title: Durango Is Coming, Pay or Die
synopsis: Brad Harris stars as a hardened bounty hunter arriving in a corrupt border outpost to track down a gang of killers who have taken over the region. Packed with brawls and fast-draw confrontations typical of director Roberto Montero's energetic exploitation style.

title: Dust in the Sun
synopsis: An obscure French-produced frontier drama focusing on psychological drama, greed, and romantic betrayals among isolated desert dwellers. Notable for an original score by Academy Award-winning French composer Francis Lai.

title: Dynamite Jack
synopsis: Legendary French comic Fernandel plays a dual role in this early western spoof, portraying both a feared, cold-blooded gunslinger named Dynamite Jack and a timid, clueless French tenderfoot who is repeatedly mistaken for him in a chaotic frontier settlement.

title: Dynamite Jim
synopsis: During the American Civil War, a Union secret agent nicknamed Dynamite Jim (Luis Dávila) attempts to escort a clandestine shipment of gold from Mexico to a northern fort, constantly fighting off Mexican bandits (Aldo Sambrell) and treacherous allies (Fernando Sancho).

title: Dynamite Joe
synopsis: Rick Van Nutter stars as Dynamite Joe, a government special agent armed with specialized explosives who is assigned to solve a rash of gold stagecoach robberies, ultimately exposing a corrupt frontier senator as the mastermind behind the thefts.

title: Eagle's Wing
synopsis: A symbolic and allegorical British-produced western written by John Briley. A solitary white trapper named Pike (Martin Sheen) and a determined Comanche warrior named White Bull (Sam Waterston) engage in a protracted, obsessive struggle over the capture of a magnificent wild white stallion. Co-stars Harvey Keitel.

title: Even Django Has His Price
alt_titles: Anche per Django Hanno un Prezzo
synopsis: Bounty hunter Django (Jeff Cameron) pursues the bank-robbing Cortez brothers to claim the reward. He crosses paths with an eccentric gambler and Wells Fargo agent who convinces him to postpone the showdown until they can uncover the location of the gang's secret gold mine, leading to a tangled web of deceit.

title: Execution
synopsis: After serving a lengthy prison sentence for an armed robbery, former convict Chips (Mimmo Palmara) is released and embarks on a hunt to eliminate his treacherous former partner John (John Richardson), who fled with the entirety of their stolen gold hoard. Directed with gritty, cynical flair by Domenico Paolella.

title: Eye for an Eye
alt_titles: Occhio per Occhio, Dente per Dente...
synopsis: A brutal, unrelenting revenge saga directed by Mexican filmmaker Alberto Mariscal. An embittered widow (Isela Vega) hires a seasoned gunfighter with a conscience (Cameron Mitchell) to teach her young son how to kill so he can avenge his father's murder, but the bounty hunter soon regrets transforming the boy into an unfeeling assassin.

title: Face to Face
synopsis: Sollima's intellectual, politically charged masterpiece tracing the psychological descent of Brad Fletcher (Gian Maria Volonté), an ailing history professor who travels west and falls under the sway of charismatic bandit Beauregard Bennet (Tomás Milian). Gradually seduced by unchecked power and violence, the professor usurps control of the gang, while Beauregard seeks redemption.

title: Fasthand
synopsis: A rogue Confederate officer named Macedo (William Berger) terrorizes an army fort and brutally shoots Captain Jeff Madison (Alan Steel) through the hands, leaving him for dead. Nursed back to health in the wilderness, Madison overcomes his physical disability to track down the guerrilla outfit with a vengeance.

title: Few Dollars for Django
synopsis: Bounty hunter Django (Anthony Steffen) tracks an elusive train robber named Jim Norton into a frontier settlement. Upon arrival, he encounters Jim's supposedly peaceful identical twin brother George (Frank Wolff). When a ruthless town syndicate begins violently seizing local farmland, Django and George team up to take on the tyrant.

title: Fifteen Scaffolds for the Killer
synopsis: Wrongfully accused of a brutal murder, Billy Mack (Craig Hill) and his companions flee from a relentless sheriff's posse and take refuge inside a crumbling, abandoned fort. Trapped under siege, the innocent men slowly turn against one another in an intense, claustrophobic psychological drama photographed by future director Stelvio Massi.

title: Fighters from Ave Maria
synopsis: A tyrannical town boss declares himself sheriff to subjugate and exploit the populace. A troupe of traveling circus acrobats led by Tony Kendall teams up with a band of exiled mountain guerrillas, combining athletic tumbling feats, traps, and gunplay to overthrow the dictator.

title: Fighting Fists of Shanghai Joe
alt_titles: Il Mio Nome È Shanghai Joe
Mezzogiorno di Fuoco per an Hao
synopsis: A famously graphic East-meets-West martial arts western. Chinese immigrant Shanghai Joe (Chen Lee) travels through the brutal American frontier, hoping to uphold his nonviolent Buddhist principles. Forced to defend himself against vicious racists and hired assassins (including Klaus Kinski as a scalp hunter), Joe uses lethal hand-to-hand combat to wipe out an entire syndicate.

title: Find a Place to Die
alt_titles: Joe, Find a Place to Die
Joe, Cercati un Posto per Morire
synopsis: When a gang of outlaws raids a gold strike and slaughters a prospector, the surviving sister (Pascale Petit) recruits a down-on-his-luck gunfighter named Joe Collins (Jeffrey Hunter) and a small band of mercenaries to help her reclaim the stolen mine from the bandits.

title: Finders Killers
synopsis: An episodic, gritty western centered on a drifter named Jack (Donald O'Brien) hunting the killers of his brother. Meanwhile, an outlaw gang conspires with a crooked town banker (Mario Brega) to hijack an army gold shipment, leading to a sprawling confrontation aided by a mysterious gunman in black (Gordon Mitchell).

title: Finger on the Trigger
synopsis: Following the Civil War, a squad of Union soldiers led by Larry Winton (Rory Calhoun) encounters a band of Confederate holdouts occupying a deserted outpost. When both factions are surrounded and besieged by hostile tribes, the former enemies join forces, melting down hidden gold horseshoes into ammunition to mount a desperate defense.

title: Fistful of Death
synopsis: A bizarre frontier tale directed by Demofilo Fidani. Gunman Macho Callaghan (Jeff Cameron) infiltrates Butch Cassidy's Wild Bunch to avenge an ambush, aided by an eccentric frontier preacher (Klaus Kinski). The two men turn out to be undercover Pinkerton agents manipulating rival gangs into destroying one another.

title: Fistful of Dollars
synopsis: The landmark film that launched the Spaghetti Western craze. Adapting Akira Kurosawa's Yojimbo, Sergio Leone casts Clint Eastwood as the nameless, poncho-clad gunfighter who rides into the border town of San Miguel and secretly manipulates two feuding crime syndicates—the Baxters and the Rojos—into wiping each other out.

title: Five Dollars for Ringo
synopsis: Despite the exploitative title, there is no character named Ringo in the film. Gunfighter Lester Sands is hired by an isolated agricultural community to defend their farms and families against marauding border bandits and a corrupt landowner seeking to evict them.

title: Five Giants from Texas
synopsis: When a homesteader is murdered and his son abducted by ruthless Mexican outlaws, five of his former companions (led by Guy Madison) band together with the grieving widow (Monica Randall) to pursue the perpetrators across the desert and bring the child home.

title: Five Man Army
synopsis: A tightly paced heist adventure scripted by Dario Argento. A mysterious strategist known as The Dutchman (Peter Graves) recruits four specialized operatives—a strongman (Bud Spencer), an acrobat, an explosives expert, and a silent samurai (Tetsuro Tamba)—to hijack a heavily guarded Mexican military train transporting a fortune in gold.

title: Five Thousand Dollars on One Ace
synopsis: Gambler Jeff Clayton (Robert Woods) wins deed to half of a ranch in a high-stakes card match. Upon arriving at the property penniless after being robbed by bandido Carrancio (Fernando Sancho), he forms an alliance with his partner and his former robber to defeat a corrupt town attorney trying to seize the land.

title: Flaming Frontier
synopsis: Stewart Granger stars as frontier hero Old Surehand alongside Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice). When a renegade outlaw known as 'The General' murders a native brave to ignite a territorial war, the heroes must race against time to calm the frontier settlements and unmask the real conspirators.

title: For a Book of Dollars
synopsis: A broad comic western about a wandering bounty hunter named Amen (Lincoln Tate) who is hired by a convent of nuns to retrieve their stolen charitable funds from a gang of bandits. After tracking down the loot, Amen discovers that the holy sisters are actually a crew of hardened female outlaws in disguise.

title: For a Few Dollars Less
synopsis: A direct slapstick parody of Sergio Leone's For a Few Dollars More, written by Sergio and Bruno Corbucci. Two bumbling frontier fools (Lando Buzzanca and Raimondo Vianello) attempt to impersonate bounty killers, inadvertently neutralizing an entire bandit gang using hallucinogenic chemicals to collect the rewards.

title: For a Few Dollars More
synopsis: The legendary second installment of Leone's Dollars trilogy. Two rival bounty hunters—the calculating Monco (Eastwood) and the vengeful Colonel Douglas Mortimer (Van Cleef)—form an uneasy truce to track down the deranged, pocket-watch-obsessed outlaw El Indio (Gian Maria Volonté) and his gang.

title: For a Fist in the Eye
synopsis: A madcap Italian comedy spoof of Fistful of Dollars. The iconic clown duo Franco and Ciccio wander into an isolated desert town only to find themselves stuck in the middle of a vicious turf war between two rival immigrant crime families battling for control of local businesses.

title: For One Hundred Thousand Dollars Per Killing
synopsis: Gianni Garko plays a stoic, deadly bounty hunter who allies himself with a hardened town sheriff to defend a territory against the marauding Clement gang. Full of cold-blooded showdowns and nihilistic atmosphere, serving as a stylistic precursor to Garko's Sartana character.

title: For One Thousand Dollars Per Day
synopsis: Young Hud (Zachary Hatcher) witnesses the murder of his family by a trio of brothers attempting to seize control of Sun Valley. Taking refuge in the hills, he learns advanced marksmanship from a paralyzed gunfighter, returning to town to take revenge by ironically hiring himself out as the killers' personal bodyguard.

title: Forewarned, Half-Killed... the Word of the Holy Ghost
alt_titles: Uomo Avvisato Mezzo Ammazzato... Parola di Spirito Santo
synopsis: Gianni Garko returns as the mythical, white-clad gunfighter known as the Holy Ghost (Spirito Santo), who carries a trained dove on his shoulder. Alongside a companion known as the Preacher, he launches an assault on a heavily fortified Mexican garrison to rescue oppressed farmers and liberate a hidden military treasure.

title: Forgotten Pistolero
synopsis: A dark, tragedy-laced western drawing direct parallels to the Oresteia myth. A traumatized gunslinger named Sebastian (Leonard Mann) tracks down the conspirators who murdered his father years earlier, only to find himself entangled in complex family betrayals and romantic intrigue.

title: Fort Yuma Gold
synopsis: As the Civil War draws to a close, a diehard Confederate commander plots a rogue attack on Fort Yuma. An ex-Rebel prisoner (Giuliano Gemma) agrees to guide Union messengers through dangerous, outlaw-patrolled territory to warn the fort before the assault begins.

title: Four Came to Kill Sartana
alt_titles: E Vennero in Quattro... per Uccidere Sartana
synopsis: In this typical Demofilo Fidani production, Jeff Cameron stars as Link, the leader of a small band of frontier vigilantes determined to bring down an outlaw gang using the Sartana moniker for terror and extortion.

title: Four Dollars for Vengeance
synopsis: Former Confederate officer Roy Dexter (Robert Woods) is framed for treason and the robbery of an army gold transport. Surviving a massacre, he returns to the frontier to hunt down the real culprits and prove his innocence, aided by a resolute frontier woman.

title: Four Gunmen of the Apocalypse
alt_titles: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse
music: Franco Bixio / Fabio Frizzi / Vince Tempera
synopsis: Lucio Fulci's grim, violent, and allegorical masterpiece. Four outcast survivors of a town massacre—a swindler, a pregnant woman, a drunkard, and a freedman—trek through the harsh wilderness. They are captured and tormented by Chaco (Tomás Milian), a sadistic, drug-crazed bandit, sparking an unrelenting quest for survival and vengeance.

title: Four Gunmen of the Holy Trinity
alt_titles: I Quattro Pistoleri di Santa Trinità
synopsis: Peter Lee Lawrence plays an undercover federal lawman disguised as an outlaw who rides into a remote territory to assist a woman whose gold mine has been seized by two vicious outlaws running an illegal weapons racket.

title: Four Rode Out
alt_titles: I Quattro sul Sentiero di Sparo
synopsis: A tense cross-border psychological chase starring Pernell Roberts as a US Marshal pursuing an accused Mexican bank robber (Julian Mateos). A resolute Pinkerton detective (Leslie Nielsen) and the fugitive's loyal lover (Sue Lyon) join the gruelling desert trek, where loyalties fray under the relentless sun.

title: Frenchie King
synopsis: An energetic French-Italian-Spanish co-production starring Brigitte Bardot and Claudia Cardinale as rival leaders of two opposing frontier factions—an all-female outlaw gang and a clan of rowdy brothers—who wage an all-out turf war over mineral rights to an oil-rich ranch.

title: Fury of Johnny Kid
synopsis: A classic revenge western where young Johnny Kid (Peter Lee Lawrence) seeks retribution against the ruthless bandit gang responsible for slaughtering his parents. Notable as the only Spaghetti Western appearance of Spanish horror icon Paul Naschy, who features as a seasoned gunman.

title: Fury of the Apaches
synopsis: When a violent tribal raid destroys an incoming wagon train, survivors are rescued by a cavalry unit led by Major Loman (Frank Latimore) and brought to a remote military outpost, where personal rivalries boil over as they prepare for a siege.

title: Garter Colt
synopsis: During the Mexican struggle against Emperor Maximilian, rebel Benito Juarez relies on a fearless female operative named Lulu (Nicoletta Machiavelli). Armed with hidden derringers, Lulu infiltrates the fortified town of Fort City to disrupt arms smugglers supplying weapons to the imperial troops. An atypical female-led adventure featuring Claudio Camaso and Walter Barnes.

title: Genius
alt_titles: Genius, Two Friends, and an Idiot
Un Genio, Due Compari, un Pollo
synopsis: Terence Hill plays Joe 'The Genius', the charismatic leader of an eccentric band of petty con-artists that includes the charming Lilla (Miou Miou) and Steamengine Bill (Robert Charlebois). Disguising themselves as a cavalry officer and his entourage, the trio infiltrates Fort Smith to orchestrate a high-stakes swindle against a corrupt commander (Patrick McGoohan).

title: Gentleman Killer
synopsis: A quiet Texas border community is overrun by a brutal band of outlaws led by the ruthless Ferreras (Eduardo Fajardo). When his brother is murdered by the gang, Gentleman Jo (Anthony Steffen) arrives in town, adopting an unassuming, soft-spoken facade while systematically dismantling the syndicate with clinical marksmanship.

title: Get Mean
music: Franco Bixio / Fabio Frizzi / Vince Tempera
synopsis: The fourth and most bizarre entry in Tony Anthony's 'Stranger' series. The American gunfighter is offered $50,000 by a gypsy mystic to escort an exiled Spanish princess (Diana Loris) back to her homeland. Upon arrival in medieval Europe, the cowboy finds himself using his sawed-off shotgun in a surreal clash between warring factions of Moors and Viking invaders.

title: Get the Coffin Ready
synopsis: Before his slapstick Trinity fame, Terence Hill starred in this direct, gritty prequel-style companion to Corbucci's Django. After his wife is murdered by his treacherous politician friend David (Horst Frank), Django becomes a traveling executioner. He secretly spares innocent condemned men using a hidden harness, forging them into a vengeful strike force that culminates in a graveyard ambush.

title: Girl Is a Gun
alt_titles: Une Aventure de Billy le Kid
synopsis: French New Wave director Luc Moullet crafts a quirky, avant-garde deconstruction of western myths. Jean-Pierre Léaud stars as an inept, erratic Billy the Kid who bumbles his way across the desert, eventually falling into an eccentric romance with an enigmatic suicidal woman while pursued by a bewildered posse and indigenous warriors.

title: Go Away! Trinity Has Arrived in Eldorado
synopsis: Two itinerant con-artists (Stan Cooper and Gordon Mitchell) wander across the territory selling fake elixir remedies and running crooked card games. Their antics hit a wall when they attempt to run a scheme against General Xavier, a vicious Mexican warlord with a short temper. A low-budget comedy outing directed by Demofilo Fidani.

title: Go Kill and Come Back
synopsis: A fast-paced, stylish caper mirroring the three-way rivalry of Leone's classics. A smooth bounty hunter (George Hilton), an American rogue (Edd Byrnes), and an experienced bandit (Gilbert Roland) engage in endless deceptions and dynamic gunfights to track down a fortune in gold bullion hidden inside the pipes of an abandoned church organ.

title: Go with God, Gringo
synopsis: Glenn Saxon stars as Gringo, an innocent cowboy who escapes from prison alongside a ruthless band of killers.
