Sickened by the gang's unchecked brutality and cruelty toward defenseless settlers, Gringo turns against his fellow escapees, eliminating them one by one to earn both a government pardon and a cash reward.

title: God Does Not Pay on Saturday
synopsis: A vicious outlaw named Lam (Larry Ward) is rescued from the gallows by his crew and immediately robs a stagecoach, fleeing into a desolate ghost town. There they torment an unassuming, retired gunfighter named Wyatt (Robert Mark) and his wife, eventually provoking Wyatt into strapping on his six-shooters for a merciless showdown.

title: God Forgives, I Don't
synopsis: The landmark film that first paired the legendary screen team of Terence Hill and Bud Spencer in a gritty, serious tone. Gunfighter Cat Stevens (Hill) and insurance investigator Hutch Bessy (Spencer) join forces to track down a gang of train robbers led by the ruthless San Antonio (Frank Wolff), who faked his own death to keep a stolen fortune in gold.

title: God in Heaven... Arizona on Earth
alt_titles: Dio in Cielo, Arizona in Terra
synopsis: Peter Lee Lawrence stars as Arizona, a sharp-shooting wanderer who rescues an elderly rancher from an assault by land-grabbers. Learning that the local baron Austin Styles is systematically slaughtering homesteaders—and was responsible for his own father's suicide—Arizona launches a methodical campaign of personal vengeance.

title: God Is My Colt .45
alt_titles: La Colt Era il Suo Dio
synopsis: A gang of cattle rustlers and corrupt businessmen led by Collins (Donald O'Brien) seizes complete control of Langford City. When an undercover investigator is assassinated, federal agent Captain Mike Jackson (Jeff Cameron) is sent covertly into the settlement, posing as an outlaw to take down the syndicate from the inside.

title: God Made Them... I Kill Them
alt_titles: Dio li Crea... Io li Ammazzo
synopsis: A bleak, uncompromising actioner starring American-born actor Dean Reed as Compton, a lethal bounty hunter hired by border town citizens to protect their gold shipments from an elusive outlaw syndicate. Suspecting an inside conspiracy, Compton discovers that the community's respected banker is the mastermind orchestrating the ambushes.

title: God Will Forgive My Pistol
synopsis: Texas Ranger Johnny Brennan (Wayde Preston) arrives in Oakland City to witness the execution of a rancher convicted of a postal robbery. Convinced by the condemned man's pleas of innocence, Brennan investigates the local elite, exposing an influential land baron (Dan Vadis) who framed the homesteader to secure valuable water rights.

title: God's Gun
synopsis: Lee Van Cleef plays a dual role: first as Father John, a peaceful frontier priest murdered by the vicious Clayton gang (led by Jack Palance), and secondly as his estranged twin brother Louis, an ex-gunfighter who returns to Juno City accompanied by a young parishioner (Leif Garrett) to exact cold-blooded retribution.

title: Gold of the Heroes
synopsis: Two Confederate rogues, Doc and Chapaqua (George Ardisson and Bobby Lapointe), unearth $100,000 in gold bars inside an abandoned military fort. Their delicate truce is shattered by the arrival of an alluring, duplicitous woman (Linda Veras) who manipulates both partners against one another to seize the treasure for an outlaw band.

title: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly
alt_titles: Il Buono, il Brutto, il Cattivo
The Good, the Bad and the Wicked
synopsis: Leone's sprawling Civil War masterpiece. Three cynical opportunists—the calculating Blondie (Eastwood), the sadistic mercenary Angel Eyes (Van Cleef), and the unprincipled rogue Tuco (Eli Wallach)—race across a war-torn southwest to uncover $200,000 in stolen Confederate gold buried in an unmarked cemetery grave, culminating in the historic three-way circular duel.

title: Grandsons of Zorro
synopsis: Slapstick duo Franco and Ciccio star in this parody as two penniless buffoons who inherit the grand estate of Don Diego de la Vega on the condition that they carry on his secret legacy as the masked avenger Zorro, stumbling into misadventures with local soldiers and frontier bandits.

title: Great Silence
synopsis: Corbucci's bleak, winter-bound masterpiece set in the snowdrifts of Utah. A mute gunfighter named Silence (Jean-Louis Trintignant), whose vocal cords were severed by outlaws as a child, is hired to defend starving outlaws and refugees from a pack of state-sanctioned, bloodthirsty bounty killers led by the sadistic Tigero (Klaus Kinski).

title: Great Treasure Hunt
synopsis: Mark Damon plays Kansas Lee, an agile gambler who teams with an alluring partner (Rosalba Neri) and a supposedly blind guide (Luis Marin) to steal a concealed hoard of gold from a notorious bandit fortress. As expected in the genre, the guide's visual handicap turns out to be an elaborate ruse.

title: Greatest Robbery in the West
alt_titles: La Più Grande Rapina del West
synopsis: A stylish heist western where charming rogue David Faylord (George Hilton) orchestrates a bank robbery by concealing stolen gold coins inside an enormous hollowed-out religious statue. Complications arise when a drunken former gunfighter (Hunt Powers) quietly diverts the loot to settle an old score with the gang's outlaw leader.

title: Gunfight at High Noon
synopsis: An influential early Eurowestern following three brothers whose father was murdered during their childhood. While Jeff (Richard Harrison) grows up to become the respected sheriff of Silver City, his brother Chet (Robert Hundar) embarks on an obsessive death hunt, leading to a tragic showdown between family loyalty and civic duty.

title: Gunfight at O Q Corral
alt_titles: Règlements de Femmes O Q Corral
synopsis: A notorious French-produced adult western novelty directed by exploitation veteran Jean-Marie Pallardy. The plot centers on Billy the Kid and his outlaw cohort abducting a female troublemaker during a frontier bank heist, which slowly manipulates the gang members into turning their weapons against one another.

title: Gunfight at Red Sands
synopsis: Considered one of the very first modern Italian-Spanish westerns, preceding Fistful of Dollars by a year. Richard Harrison plays Gringo Martinez, an adopted son of a Mexican family who returns home to find his father murdered and his brother wounded by a gang of racist outlaws, embarking on a methodical pursuit of justice.

title: Gunfighters of Casa Grande
synopsis: A group of American outlaws led by Joe Daylight (Alex Nicol) wins a sprawling Mexican hacienda in a poker match. Planning to use the estate as a cover to rustle local herds, the bandits gradually grow attached to the local community, taking a stand to defend the ranch against a vicious bandit army led by Rojo (Aldo Sambrell).

title: Gunman of One Hundred Crosses
synopsis: Tony Kendall stars as Django, a traveling gunfighter who assists a resilient widowed rancher (Marina Mulligan) after her husband is murdered by henchmen working for an extortionist town boss (Mimmo Palmara). Django schools the determined widow in firearms so she can participate in defending her homestead.

title: Gunmen and the Holy Ghost
alt_titles: Spirito Santo e le 5 Magnifiche Canaglie
synopsis: Vassili Karis stars in Roberto Mauri's unofficial sequel to the Holy Ghost series. Playing the cape-wearing marksman, he and his gruff companion recruit a specialized unit of sharpshooters and mercenaries to defend a defenseless agricultural settlement from marauding Mexican outlaws.

title: Gunmen of Rio Grande
alt_titles: Jennie Lee Ha una Nuova Pistola
synopsis: When a corrupt mine owner terrorizes the Mexican settlement of Rio Bravo, a French saloon proprietor writes to legendary lawman Wyatt Earp (Guy Madison) for assistance. Unable to act legally as a marshal in Mexico, Earp adopts an alias and rides south as a hired gun to dismantle the syndicate.

title: Guns for San Sebastian
synopsis: Filmed entirely on location in Mexico. Anthony Quinn stars as an army deserter and rogue who is mistaken for a Catholic priest by the impoverished villagers of San Sebastian. Embracing the role, he organizes the peasants into a fortified military resistance against a renegade bandit leader (Charles Bronson) and hostile native raiders.

title: Half Breed
synopsis: Part of the classic Karl May franchise. Frontier scout Old Shatterhand (Lex Barker) and Apache chief Winnetou (Pierre Brice) intervene when predatory white claim-jumpers discover that a young half-breed woman (Ursula Glass) has inherited the rights to a secret, sacred gold mine on her twenty-first birthday.

title: Halleluja and Sartana Strike Again
alt_titles: Alleluja & Sartana Are Sons... of God
Alleluja e Sartana Figli di... Dio
synopsis: A slapstick Trinity-style buddy comedy pairing TV's Tarzan, Ron Ely, with Alberto Dell'Acqua. Disguised as frontier priests, the two bumbling bandits arrive in Redemption City and find it dominated by a ruthless gang. Allied with an attractive widow (Uschi Glas), they turn an abandoned church into an insurgent headquarters.

title: Halleluja to Vera Cruz
synopsis: Two roguish con-artists posing as Catholic priests (Lionel Stander and Riccardo Salvino) gain the trust of a band of Mexican revolutionaries. Hearing of a $500,000 army payroll transport, the faux-friars race to intercept the money, navigating comedic brawls and greedy land barons.

title: Hands of a Gunman
synopsis: Craig Hill stars as Galen Stark, a notorious gunslinger who hangs up his weapons to settle down to a quiet family existence with his new bride (Gloria Milland). His past refuses to die, however, as ruthless bounty hunters and former rivals relentlessly track him to his remote retreat.

title: Handsome, the Ugly, and the Stupid
alt_titles: Il Bello, il Brutto, e il Cretino
synopsis: A direct slapstick spoof of Sergio Leone's The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly. Franco and Ciccio play two bumbling frontier idiots who possess half the coordinates to a buried Confederate treasure, teaming up with a rugged gunfighter named Handsome (Mimmo Palmara) to dig up graves across the West.

title: Hannie Caulder
synopsis: Raquel Welch stars as Hannie Caulder, a frontier woman whose husband is murdered and homestead torched by the depraved Clemens brothers (Ernest Borgnine, Jack Elam, and Strother Martin). A passing bounty hunter (Robert Culp) mentors her in precision marksmanship with the help of a craftsman gunsmith (Christopher Lee), setting her on a deadly quest for revenge.

title: Hate for Hate
synopsis: An escaped convict (John Ireland) attempts to return stolen loot to an impoverished young sculptor (Antonio Sabàto). When the convict's ruthless former associates raid the home and kidnap the artist's family, the two men join forces to track down the gang in a stylish, violent pursuit written by Fernando Di Leo.

title: Hate Thy Neighbor
synopsis: A ruthless bandit (George Eastman) murders a prospector to steal a map to a rich gold vein on orders from a corrupt landowner (Horst Frank). The victim's brother sets off into Mexico to avenge the killing, navigating a decadent estate where the host stages gladiator-style combat between slaves armed with razor-sharp claws.

title: Hatred of God
synopsis: A dark, nihilistic revenge tale starring Tony Kendall as Carl, a peaceful rancher whose life is shattered when a marauding bandit crew brutally attacks his homestead and slaughters his wife. Hardened by tragedy, Carl picks up his rifles and embarks on a relentless, cold-blooded manhunt across the frontier.

title: Have a Good Funeral, My Friend... Sartana Will Pay
synopsis: Gianni Garko returns as Sartana, the supernatural-tinged avenger of the frontier. Arriving in a mining settlement following the murder of a wealthy prospector, Sartana exposes a conspiracy orchestrated by a corrupt banker and a deceptive heiress, utilizing his signature arsenal of trick gadgets and miniature firearms.

title: He Was Called the Holy Ghost
synopsis: Vassili Karis takes over the title role in this unofficial follow-up to the popular Holy Ghost series. Dressed in a pristine white cape, the mysterious marksman arrives in a rural frontier territory to dismantle a crooked land-grabbing foreclosure scheme run by a corrupt sheriff and a treacherous town financier.

title: Heads or Tails
synopsis: John Ericson plays bounty hunter Will Hunter, who rides into a lawless border town tracking a charismatic bandit and gambler named Serpiente. Along the way, he intervenes to rescue a young woman (Edwige Fenech) from sadistic outlaws in a drama punctuated by stylized torture setpieces and frontier shootouts.

title: Heads You Die... Tails I Kill You
alt_titles: Testa t'Ammazzo, Croce Sei Morto... Mi Chiamano Alleluia!
synopsis: George Hilton stars as the smooth gunfighter Hallelujah, hired by a revolutionary general to seize a shipment of royal jewels being used to purchase advanced firearms. Navigating rival secret agents, undercover spies disguised as nuns, and a Russian prince, Hallelujah triggers a chaotic web of double-crosses.

title: Hellbenders
synopsis: Sergio Corbucci's grim, psychological masterpiece starring Joseph Cotten as Jonas, a fanatical former Confederate colonel who refuses to accept the South's defeat. With his sons, Jonas ambushes a Union gold transport and hides the stolen fortune inside a coffin, undertaking a treacherous journey across the plains under the guise of escorting a dead officer's body.

title: Here We Go Again, Eh Providence?
synopsis: A sequel to Sometimes Life Is Hard, Right Providence?, featuring Tomás Milian as the eccentric, bowler-hatted bounty hunter Providence. Teaming up once again with the hulking outlaw Hurricane Kid, the duo engages in convoluted schemes involving counterfeit bounties, high-society heists, and romantic misadventures.

title: Hero Called Allegria
alt_titles: His Name Was Pot... But They Called Him Allegria
director: Demofilo Fidani (as Dennis Ford / Slim Alone)
synopsis: Two inept bandit brothers, Pot and Ray (Peter Martell and Gordon Mitchell), pull off a chaotic bank robbery, only to be ambushed and stripped of their loot by a rival gang leader named Lobo (Lincoln Tate). The surviving brother embarks on a clumsy quest to recover the stolen money.

title: Heroes of the West
synopsis: A broad, lighthearted frontier comedy starring Italian comic duo Walter Chiari and Raimondo Vianello as two charming rogues who impersonate the heirs to a lucrative gold mine, finding themselves caught in the middle of a vicious blood feud between two rival pioneer families.

title: Hey Amigo! A Toast to Your Death!
synopsis: Wayde Preston plays a hardened, aging bounty hunter who journeys deep into the badlands of northern Mexico to apprehend a notorious bandit leader. Along the way, the mission evolves into an armed hunt for a hidden Confederate treasure buried in the desert.

title: Hills Run Red
synopsis: At the end of the Civil War, two Confederate soldiers steal an army payroll, but one partner betrays the other and leaves him to rot in prison. Years later, the wronged veteran (Thomas Hunter) returns to find his former friend has built a criminal empire protected by a sadistic killer (Henry Silva), sparking an explosive town siege.

title: His Name Was Holy Ghost
synopsis: Gianni Garko introduces his iconic Holy Ghost character, a suave, white-clad sharpshooter with a dove perched upon his shoulder. Fighting for law and order, the vigilante defends border-town settlers from Mexican bandits while scheming to take control of a profitable gold mine won in a card game.

title: His Name Was King
synopsis: When his brother is murdered and his sister-in-law brutally assaulted by the notorious Benson gang, John 'King' Marley (Richard Harrison) embarks on an obsessive manhunt. His search for the gunrunners leads to a shocking confrontation when he discovers his friend, the local sheriff (Klaus Kinski), is the secret syndicate kingpin.

title: His Name Was Sam Walbash, But They Call Him Amen
alt_titles: Era Sam Walbash... Lo Chiamavano 'Così Sia'
synopsis: When a sadistic gang leader (Dean Stratford) shoots up a frontier saloon to silence an informant, he murders an innocent youth. The victim's brother, Sam Walbash (Robert Woods), tracks the outlaw into Golden City, where the bandit has adopted a new identity, setting up an inevitable final confrontation.

title: Hole in the Forehead
synopsis: A ruthless Mexican bandit named Manguja (Robert Hundar) hunts across the desert for a fortune in hidden gold. However, an enigmatic and deadly bounty hunter named John Blood (Anthony Ghidra) gets to the treasure first, donating the loot to a monastery before facing Manguja in a final duel.

title: Holy Water Joe
synopsis: When an outlaw gang led by Jeff Donovan (Ty Hardin) robs a frontier bank, they inadvertently steal the life savings of notorious bounty hunter Acquasanta Joe (Lincoln Tate). Joe tracks down the bandit, and the two form an uneasy alliance to hunt a rogue associate (Richard Harrison) who has run off with the gold.

title: Hour of Death
synopsis: A dramatic frontier chronicle detailing the trials of a pioneer wagon train traveling through hostile territories. Personal rivalries, indigenous attacks, and opportunistic bandits constantly threaten the expedition, culminating in an unexpected and somber finale.

title: Hunting Party
synopsis: A brutal, big-budget European-filmed western. An illiterate bandit leader (Oliver Reed) kidnaps the schoolteacher wife (Candice Bergen) of a wealthy, psychopathic cattle baron (Gene Hackman) so she can teach him to read. Armed with custom long-range rifles, the husband and his aristocratic hunting party track the outlaw gang, turning the chase into an unrelenting bloodbath.

title: I Am Sartana, Trade Your Guns for a Coffin
alt_titles: Sartana's Coming, Get Your Coffins Ready
C'è Sartana, Vendi la Pistola e Comprati la Bara
synopsis: George Hilton steps into the role of Sartana for this official entry in the series. Sartana joins forces with fellow gunfighter Sabata (Charles Southwood) to foil a corrupt banker who is conspiring with a Mexican bandit outfit. Packed with gadgetry, trick weapons, and fast-paced shootouts.

title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
synopsis: When a criminal gang impersonates Sartana during a daring bank robbery, a massive bounty is placed on his head, attracting an army of ruthless bounty hunters (including Klaus Kinski and Gordon Mitchell). Sartana must use his wits, sleight of hand, and unique four-barreled derringer to clear his reputation and expose the corrupt bankers behind the scheme.

title: I Came, I Saw, I Shot
synopsis: A comedic caper focusing on two unlikely partners, Edwin (Frank Wolff) and Moses (Antonio Sabàto), who steal $300,000 from a frontier bank. They are tracked down by a gambler named Clay (John Saxon) who claims ownership of the loot, forcing the three squabbling men to team up when Mexican outlaws attempt to take the treasure.

title: I Do Not Forgive... I Kill!
synopsis: A dramatic, violent romance following a determined bounty hunter (Simon Andreu) who falls deeply in love with a woman named Lucy (Norma Bengell). Complications arise when he discovers that her outlaw brother (James Philbrook) is the very fugitive he has been contracted to hunt down and kill.

title: I Want Him Dead
synopsis: When an outlaw gang assassintes a guide's sister en route to disrupt a Civil War peace conference, frontier guide Clayton (Craig Hill) vows bloody retribution. Operating entirely outside the law, Clayton relentlessly hunts down each member of the gang, foiling a wider conspiracy in the process.

title: If One Is Born a Swine
synopsis: Bandit leader Pepito (Fernando Sancho) acts as hired muscle for a greedy town boss seeking to seize a productive gold mine. Gunfighting stranger Billy Walsh (Richard Wyler) rides to the rescue of the elderly mine owner and his daughter, leading to a series of violent clashes with Sancho's gang.

title: If One Is Born a Swine... Kill Him
synopsis: A powerful cattle syndicate gains control of the local bank and institutes an aggressive foreclosure campaign against struggling farmers. An undercover federal lawman known as 'Il Mulo' (Glenn Saxon) poses as a notorious hired gun, aligning with a local attorney to protect the settlers.

title: If You Shoot... You Live!
synopsis: A late-cycle Spanish production remaking the narrative of If You Want to Live, Shoot!. James Philbrook plays a recovering wounded gunfighter who steps in to defend a widowed homesteader from the predations of a wealthy regional land baron (Frank Braña).

title: If You Want to Live... Shoot!
alt_titles: Django, If You Want to Live... Shoot!
synopsis: A despotic land baron named Marlow (Ivan Rassimov) hires Mexican bandits to terrorize local homesteaders into selling their farms. Meanwhile, a wounded gunfighter named Johnny is nursed back to health by a widow; when the gang destroys her property, Johnny embarks on a lethal crusade to eliminate Marlow.

title: I'll Sell My Skin Dearly
synopsis: After his entire family is slaughtered by a vicious gang, Shane (Mike Marshall) spends years mastering firearms on an abandoned ranch. Once his skills are honed, he ventures out to methodically track down and execute everyone involved, including a former bandit who has since taken holy vows as a priest.

title: In a Colt's Shadow
synopsis: Two hired gunfighters successfully defend a Mexican village from outlaws, but their friendship fractures when one partner falls in love with the other's daughter. Moving to Texas to start a peaceful life, the lovers are targeted by a local syndicate, forcing the two former allies to reunite in a massive town gunfight.

title: In the Name of the Father
synopsis: An obscure and rarely seen comedy-western directed by cult horror filmmaker Ruggero Deodato early in his career, following a group of four misfits navigating frontier scrapes and misadventures.

title: In the Name of the Father, the Son and the Colt
alt_titles: Au Nom du Père, du Fils et du Colt
synopsis: Sheriff Johnston (Craig Hill) investigates a series of daring stagecoach robberies carried out by a mysterious gang of outlaws who disguise themselves in outlandish costumes, including saloon girls, to ambush their unsuspecting prey.

title: It Can Be Done... Amigo
synopsis: A lively, slapstick-infused western comedy pairing Bud Spencer as the roguish Coburn with Jack Palance as Sonny Bronston, a theatrical, blustery gunslinger pursuing Coburn for compromising his sister's honor. Along the way, Coburn inherits custody of an orphaned boy with valuable oil-rich land.

title: Jaguar
synopsis: Cult auteur Jess Franco directs this unique adventure set during civil unrest in South America. José Suarez plays Llanos (also called 'Jaguar'), a mountain rebel leading a revolutionary guerrilla faction fighting against an oppressive military general and a corrupt magistrate.

title: Jesse and Lester, Two Brothers in a Place Called Trinity
alt_titles: Due Fratelli i un Posto Chiamato Trinità
synopsis: Directed by and starring Richard Harrison alongside Donald O'Brien. Two vastly different brothers—one a charming, womanizing scoundrel and the other a devout Mormon preacher—inherit a substantial fortune, but their conflicting plans are put on hold when bandits rob the inheritance.

title: Jesse James' Kid
synopsis: Twenty years after the legendary outlaw Jesse James is assassinated in his home, his grown son Billy (Robert Hundar) goes undercover at a regional horse ranch. Learning that the rival rancher conspiring to seize the land is the very man who murdered his father, Billy launches a bullet-riddled vendetta.

title: Joe Dexter
synopsis: Drifter and quick-draw expert Joe Dexter (George Martin) settles in Iron City, where he becomes romantically entangled with two women. When a jealous saloon owner conspires with a mine manager to steal an inherited silver claim, Joe takes up arms in a decisive town showdown.

title: John the Bastard
synopsis: A unique western retelling of the Don Juan and Casanova myths. John Tenerico (John Richardson) is an amorous seducer and lethal gunman who travels across the frontier leaving broken hearts and dead rivals in his wake, until a vengeful religious sect dispatches an assassin (Gordon Mitchell) to end his reign.

title: Johnny Colt
synopsis: Robert Woods plays Starblack, a masked Robin Hood-style avenger who adopts a mild-mannered alter ego to undermine the corrupt, extortionist grip that a crooked banker (Franco Lantieri) holds over an oppressed mining community.

title: Johnny Hamlet
synopsis: Castellari directs a Shakespearean tragedy reframed as a spaghetti western. Returning from the Civil War, Johnny discovers his father dead and his mother married to his villainous Uncle Claude (Horst Frank). Suspecting assassination, Johnny conducts a deadly investigation aided by a wandering mentor (Gilbert Roland).

title: Johnny Yuma
synopsis: A violent, iconic western starring Mark Damon as Johnny Yuma, a skilled gunfighter who arrives to claim his murdered uncle's ranch. He runs afoul of the scheming widow Samantha (Rosalba Neri) and her hired assassin Carradine (Lawrence Dobkin), but Johnny and Carradine develop a mutual respect that upends the murder plot.

title: Judge Roy Bean
alt_titles: La Loi à l'Ouest de Pecos
director: Jean Girault / Robert Hossein (as Richard Owens)
synopsis: Robert Hossein stars as the eccentric, self-appointed hanging judge Roy Bean, governing his frontier territory with autocratic rule. When a federal investigator arrives to challenge his legal jurisdiction, political maneuvering and comedic frontier violence collide.

title: Keoma
synopsis: One of the crowning achievements of the twilight era of Spaghetti Westerns. Half-breed gunslinger Keoma (Franco Nero) returns to his plague-ravaged hometown to find it dominated by an ex-Confederate tyrant and his own three treacherous half-brothers. Aided by his father (William Berger) and a freedman friend (Woody Strode), Keoma wages a mythic, slow-motion battle of redemption.

title: Kid Rodelo
synopsis: Based on a Louis L'Amour novel, Don Murray stars as Kid Rodelo, recently freed from prison and attempting to recover a hidden cache of gold. Pursued by an outlaw gang and an enigmatic woman (Janet Leigh), the expedition across the desert devolves into a desperate survival trek against native war parties.

title: Kid Vengeance
synopsis: A brutal exploitation western filmed in Israel. Pop star Leif Garrett plays a young boy whose parents are slaughtered and sister abducted by a psychotic outlaw band led by Lee Van Cleef. The boy joins forces with an enigmatic black gunfighter (Jim Brown) to track down the gang and execute them.

title: Kill Django... Kill First
synopsis: Bounty hunter Django (Giacomo Rossi Stuart) is tasked with hunting down Ramon (George Wang), a notorious Mexican outlaw leading a gang of bandits in a series of violent raids across the Texas borderlands.

title: Kill Johnny Ringo
synopsis: Texas Ranger Johnny Ringo (Brett Halsey) is dispatched to Eagle Pass to investigate a widespread counterfeiting racket. Posing as a traveling gambler, Ringo follows the trail of bogus currency directly to the town's corrupt civic leaders, culminating in an explosive saloon battle.

title: Kill or Die
synopsis: Capitalizing on the popularity of the Ringo name, Robert Mark plays a mysterious violin-playing wanderer who intervenes in a vicious territorial feud, defending a vulnerable family against a powerful, aggressive frontier clan.

title: Kill the Poker Player
synopsis: Professional gambler and quick-draw ace Ace (Robert Woods) runs into deadly trouble when he exposes a corrupt town boss (Frank Braña) as a card cheat. After stealing the boss's saloon-singer lover (Nieves Navarro), Ace finds himself marked for death by a cadre of hired assassins.

title: Kill Them All and Come Back Alone
alt_titles: Go Kill Everybody and Come Back Alone
synopsis: A fast-paced, action-packed military heist film. Captured Confederate soldier Clyde Link (Chuck Connors) leads a specialized team of mercenaries to infiltrate an impregnable Union fortress and steal a fortune in gold. The mission succeeds, but a series of ruthless double-crosses leaves Link clawing his way out of a grave to hunt down his treacherous partners.

title: Killer Caliber .32
synopsis: When a regular stagecoach run is repeatedly ambushed and plundered by a gang of masked bandits, bank executives hire a dapper, sharply dressed bounty hunter named Silver (Peter Lee Lawrence). Through meticulous investigation, Silver discovers that the leader of the outlaws is none other than the bank director himself.

title: Killer Goodbye
synopsis: Jess Frain (Peter Lee Lawrence) returns to his home town of Fulton City to clear his name and re-establish law and order alongside the sheriff. He is confronted by two warring factions fighting for economic control of the town, discovering that a corrupt mastermind (Eduardo Fajardo) is pulling the strings from the shadows.

title: Killer Kid
synopsis: An American government agent (Anthony Steffen) goes undercover in revolutionary Mexico as an arms smuggler known as Killer Kid. Witnessing the immense suffering of the Mexican peasants at the hands of a tyrannical military regime, his political loyalties shift, leading him to join the rebel forces in a desperate assault.

title: Kitosch, the Man Who Came from the North
synopsis: George Hilton stars as Major Zachary Baker of the Canadian Mounted Police, tasked with transporting $500,000 in gold bars through hostile wilderness to Fort Eagles. To protect the payload, he conceals the gold inside five coffins escorted by a mourning party of widows, only to find the destination fort destroyed by outlaws.

title: Kung Fu Brothers in the Wild West
synopsis: An East-meets-West curiosity produced between Italy and Hong Kong. Two Chinese brothers travel to the American West, encountering racism and violence from local outlaws while fulfilling a mission to protect an immigrant settlement against a rogue samurai assassin.

title: Land Raiders
synopsis: A bigoted land baron (Telly Savalas) attempts to drive out local native tribes by paying townsfolk bounties for scalps. His estranged brother (George Maharis) returns to the territory just in time to stop his violent campaign, triggering a major family showdown and armed confrontation across the border.

title: Last Gun
synopsis: A notorious gunslinger (Cameron Mitchell) decides to hang up his pistols and retire peacefully to a quiet frontier settlement. When an aggressive outlaw gang terrorizes the townspeople and corrupts the local authorities, he is forced to strap on his six-guns one final time to restore order.

title: Last of the Mohicans
synopsis: A European western adaptation inspired by James Fenimore Cooper's classic novel. Scout Hawkeye and his Mohican companion Luncas (Dan Martin) join forces with a British officer (Jack Taylor) to thwart a corrupt fort commander and hostile warriors conspiring to drive settlers from the frontier.

title: Last Rebel
synopsis: Former NFL star Joe Namath plays Burnside Hollis, an ex-Confederate soldier who rescues a former slave (Woody Strode) from a lynching at the close of the Civil War. The pair team up with a partner (Jack Elam) running pool-hall scams until greed and betrayal lead to a climactic duel.

title: Last Ride to Santa Cruz
alt_titles: Der Letzte Ritt nach Santa Cruz
synopsis: A corrupt sheriff (Mario Adorf) wrongfully frames and imprisons an innocent frontiersman (Edmund Purdom). Escaping from federal custody years later, the vengeful fugitive returns to the territory to clear his name and take down the crooked lawman's syndicate. Co-stars Klaus Kinski.

title: Last Tomahawk
synopsis: A companion to the Karl May frontier films, starring Anthony Steffen as Strongheart and Dan Martin as Chinga. The heroes struggle to maintain peace and prevent a catastrophic war between feuding native tribes and manipulative frontier land speculators.

title: Law of Violence
synopsis: Retired bounty hunter Lester Moore (George Greenwood) accepts the position of sheriff in a small border town that is plagued by nightly assaults from an elusive band of Mexican outlaws. Moore uses his tactical experience to lay a trap for the gang.

title: Left Handed Johnny West
synopsis: Mimmo Palmara stars as legendary southpaw marksman Johnny West, a roaming lawman investigating the murder of an affluent mine owner. Despite local accusations pointing toward two outlaw brothers, West uncovers the real conspiracy orchestrated by regional officials.

title: Legacy of the Incas
alt_titles: El Último Rey de los Incas
synopsis: A unique South American western set in the mountains of Peru. Guy Madison plays Wutuma, the last royal descendant of the Incas, who is tasked by the Peruvian president (Fernando Rey) with preventing a violent insurrection led by a renegade native leader and rogue bandits.

title: Lemonade Joe
synopsis: A celebrated Czechoslovakian musical western satire. Karel Fiala plays the pristine, teetotaling cowboy Lemonade Joe, whose superhuman marksmanship is fueled entirely by Kolaloka lemonade. Joe arrives in Stetson City to wage war on whiskey-drinking outlaws and corrupt saloon tycoons.

title: Let Them Rest
synopsis: A surreal and politically charged gothic western. Lou Castel plays Requiescant, a gentle young man raised by a preacher who discovers an innate, lethal gift for shooting. He embarks on a quest to find his foster sister, confronting a decadent and sadistic aristocratic land baron played by Mark Damon.

title: Let's Go and Kill Sartana
synopsis: Two former prison inmates, Clay and Greg (George Martin and Gordon Mitchell), part ways upon their release—one seeking an honest life and the other immediately returning to highway robbery. When Greg's gang raids Clay's family ranch, an inevitable duel ensues. The Sartana of the title is entirely absent from the film.

title: Light the Fuse... Sartana Is Coming
alt_titles: Cloud of Dust... Cry of Death
Una Nuvola di Polvere... un Grido di Morte, Arriva Sartana
synopsis: Gianni Garko returns as Sartana, breaking a fellow gambler out of prison to clear him of a false murder charge. Navigating a landscape of deceit, bounty hunters, and double-crossing town officials, Sartana uncovers a stolen fortune hidden in a web of musical instruments and clockwork devices.

title: Long Day of the Massacre
synopsis: A gritty, low-budget 1968 entry following an embittered gunslinger (Peter Martell) who finds himself trapped in a volatile territory controlled by competing outlaw factions. Aided by a mysterious drifter (Glenn Saxon), he fights his way through a wave of ambush attempts.

title: Long Days of Vengeance
synopsis: A loose adaptation of The Count of Monte Cristo set in the American West. Ted Barnett (Giuliano Gemma) escapes from prison to prove he was framed for his father's murder, systematically hunting down the corrupt sheriff and the traitorous arms-smuggler (Conrado Sanmartin) responsible.

title: Long Ride from Hell
synopsis: Bodybuilding icon Steve Reeves stars in his only western as Mike, a rancher framed for horse theft by a corrupt cattle baron (Wayde Preston). Escaping from a brutal prison camp after his brother dies, Mike returns to Yuma City to exact retribution with the assistance of a saloon woman (Rosalba Neri).

title: Lost Treasure of the Incas
alt_titles: Sansone e il Tesoro degli Incas
synopsis: Peplum muscleman Alan Steel stars as Samson alongside gunfighter Alan Fox. When an innocent man is murdered by a crooked town boss, the heroes assist the victim's daughter, leading them into an adventurous quest that uncovers the hidden ruins and gold of a lost Inca civilization.

title: Lucky Johnny: Born in America
synopsis: Filmed in Mexico, this gritty production follows Johnny, a notorious marksman raised by an eccentric undertaker. When Johnny falls in love with a woman trapped in an abusive marriage to a violent outlaw chieftain, the conflict explodes into a lethal desert pursuit.

title: Machine Gun Killers
alt_titles: Quel Caldo Maledetto Giorno di Fuoco
synopsis: When the inventor of a revolutionary rapid-fire Gatling gun is abducted by a ruthless Mexican mercenary (John Ireland), Union officer Chris Tanner (Robert Woods) is framed for treason. Escaping custody, Tanner launches a desperate manhunt to rescue the inventor and recover the weapon.

title: Macho Killers
synopsis: World middleweight boxing champion Carlos Monzon plays El Macho, a gambler who impersonates a deceased outlaw to infiltrate a gang commanded by an eccentric, champagne-sipping bandit (George Hilton). When the corrupt local sheriff double-crosses him, a massive town-square firefight erupts.

title: Mad Dog Morgan
synopsis: A fierce Australian bushranger classic sharing the raw DNA of the Eurowestern. Dennis Hopper gives an unhinged, hypnotic performance as legendary historical outlaw Dan Morgan, who turns to banditry to survive and wages a bloody guerrilla war against the colonial authorities across the 1850s Australian wilderness.

title: Magnificent Brutes of the West
synopsis: A slapstick frontier farce featuring the comedy troupe 'I Quattro Brutos'. When four bumbling handymen inadvertently wipe out a bandit crew in Fresno, they take over the local mortuary business, getting caught between a dedicated undercover marshal (Giacomo Rossi Stuart) and a hostile outlaw gang.

title: Magnificent Texan
synopsis: Glenn Saxon plays Manny, an unassuming saloon keeper who secretly acts as a masked Robin Hood-style hero for oppressed Mexican peasants. While defending the community from a tyrannical land baron and his sadistic son, Manny systematically settles the score for his parents' murder.

title: Magnificent Three
synopsis: An early Spanish-Italian effort following three loyal frontier comrades (Geoffrey Horne, Robert Hundar, and Paul Piaget) who rally pioneer settlers to defend their territory and ranches from an invasion by an aggressive bandit outfit led by Fernando Sancho.

title: Magnificent West
synopsis: Vassili Karis plays an agile, roguish adventurer searching across the frontier for a shipment of stolen gold bullion misappropriated by his former partner. His investigation leads him into constant clashes with outlaws, culminating in a showdown with a ruthless rival played by Gordon Mitchell.

title: Mallory Must Not Die
alt_titles: My Name Is Mallory... M Means Death
Il Mio Nome È Mallory... 'M' Come Morte
synopsis: A laconic bounty hunter named Mallory (Robert Woods) tracks an escaped killer into the small mining community of Coppermine. As he falls in love with a local woman, Mallory must untangle a web of town corruption to draw his target into a final street showdown.

title: Man: His Pride and His Vengeance
synopsis: Based on Prosper Mérimée's novel Carmen, this dark, anti-heroic drama stars Franco Nero as José, an honorable Spanish soldier whose obsession with an alluring gypsy woman (Tina Aumont) destroys his military career, plunging him into banditry, jealousy, and multiple murders. Features Klaus Kinski as a ruthless outlaw partner.

title: Man and a Colt
synopsis: Robert Hundar stars as Dallas, a rogue gunfighter who uncovers a clandestine alliance between an influential town boss and a notorious Mexican bandit leader (Fernando Sancho). Learning that the syndicate plans to raid the Texas Reserve Bank, Dallas prepares an ambush to foil the heist.

title: Man Called Amen
synopsis: A martial-arts-infused frontier comedy following a sharp-shooting rogue named Horacio (Luc Merenda) who reunites with his double-crossing former partner (Alfio Caltabiano), now operating a corrupt church front. Together with an eccentric band of misfits, they plan a bank robbery that spirals into broad slapstick.

title: Man Called Blade
synopsis: A dark, atmospheric masterpiece from Sergio Martino. Maurizio Merli stars as Blade, an axe-wielding bounty hunter who arrives in a rain-drenched silver town. When a sadistic mine manager (John Steiner) tortures and attempts to blind Blade, the resilient warrior trains his senses in darkness to carry out a brutal, hatchet-wielding massacre.

title: Man Called Django
synopsis: Anthony Steffen stars as Django, an ice-cold gunfighter tracking the four renegades who raped and killed his lover. Rescuing an escaped prisoner who knows the identities of the killers, Django infiltrates an arms-smuggling ring supplying weapons to Mexican revolutionaries to execute his vengeance.

title: Man Called Gringo
synopsis: A rancher paralyzed in an accident entrusts his estate to a corrupt attorney who secretly plots his ruin. The lawyer hires a wandering outlaw named Gringo to eliminate the rancher, unaware that Gringo is the man's long-lost son. The deception is exposed by a mysterious federal marshal (Götz George).

title: Man Called Invincible
alt_titles: In the West There Was a Man Named Invincible
synopsis: George Hilton plays Tressette, a flamboyant, gadget-wielding gambler hired to transport gold from Wagon Bend to Dallas. When a corrupt banker swindles the shipment and disguises the gold dust inside export cakes, Tressette and his companions launch an elaborate, action-packed plan to reclaim the fortune.
